You will be pivotal to telli’s growth. Your mission is to drive revenue by building trusted relationships with enterprise customers and closing complex, high-value deals (€100k+ land deal size). As one of the first Enterprise AEs at telli, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we win, navigate, and scale our enterprise sales motion.

what you'll do:

  • Own complex enterprise deals end-to-end: Lead €100k+ deals from first discovery through signature, including demos, business cases, security reviews, procurement, legal, contract negotiations, and executive alignment. You uncover where telli creates measurable value and build the case to make it a priority.

  • Build and own your pipeline: Our SDR team supports you, but you can generate own Enterprise pipeline. You identify the right accounts, develop account strategies, write outbound, make the calls, and create opportunities where none existed before.

  • Navigate complex buying committees: Build relationships across Sales, Operations, CX, IT, Security, Legal, Procurement, Finance, and the C-Suite at large organizations. You identify champions, understand internal politics, and create consensus across multiple stakeholders.

  • Run strategic, multi-threaded sales processes: You don't rely on a single champion. You map the organization, understand who influences the decision, and build relationships at multiple levels long before procurement enters the process.

  • Own a quota and close €100k+ deals: Drive meaningful new ARR and take full accountability for your forecast, pipeline coverage, and revenue target.

  • Build compelling business cases: Translate telli's product into measurable commercial impact for the customer and make the ROI clear enough to win internal budget and executive sponsorship.

  • Bring the customer into the company: Feed structured insights back into product, marketing, and strategy. You sit closest to some of our most important prospects and customers, and your signal helps shape what we build next.

what makes you a great fit:

  • You've successfully closed enterprise deals: You have proven experience owning complex €100k+ sales cycles and selling to senior and C-Suite economic buyers.

  • You know how to navigate complexity: You've worked through long sales cycles involving multiple departments, procurement, security, legal, and competing internal priorities, without losing control of the deal.

  • You're an elite relationship builder: You know the difference between a contact, a champion, and an economic buyer. You build trust quickly and have won deals because of the relationships you created across an organization.

  • You're a hunter: You know how to manufacture pipeline without relying on a warm inbound stream. You're comfortable breaking into large accounts and creating urgency from scratch.

  • You're commercially sharp: You understand how to build a business case, quantify value, negotiate confidently, and protect deal quality while getting complex agreements across the line.

  • You're obsessively prepared: You know more about the prospect's business, priorities, and challenges than they expect you to. Every interaction has a purpose.

  • You're low ego and high accountability: You're not above doing the grunt work. You take ownership when things go wrong, act on feedback quickly, and share credit when things go right.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description:
GTM Engineer

Nylon builds AI research tools that are changing how lawyers and accountants work. 2,000+ firms across New Zealand, Australia and the UK trust our platform, from the biggest firms in the world to small specialist practices.

Our go-to-market team runs on data. The quality of our outreach lists, the accuracy of our CRM and the reliability of the systems that connect them decide how well our sales and marketing efforts perform. We're hiring a GTM Engineer to own that data layer.

The role

You'll build and maintain the pipelines that find, enrich and deliver prospect data to our sales team, keep the CRM clean and trustworthy, and connect the tools in our stack so information flows without manual effort. It's a hands-on technical role at the intersection of sales operations, data and automation. Not a sales role, and not a pure engineering role. You'll report to our Head of Go-to-Market, work closely with our account executives, SDRs and marketing, and have a lot of freedom in how you solve problems.

What you'll be doing

Outreach data and list building

  • Building targeted prospect lists across NZ, AU and the UK from the ideal customer profiles the GTM team defines, covering firm type, size, practice area, location and seniority

  • Sourcing data from multiple channels, including scraping public sources, enrichment platforms (Clay, Apollo or similar), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, professional body registers and our own product and website data

  • Designing waterfall enrichment flows that verify contact details, fill gaps and score leads, keeping bounce and unsubscribe rates low

  • Using AI tooling to research accounts at scale, qualify fit, personalise outreach inputs and automate the repetitive parts of list building

  • Maintaining data quality, deduplication and consent standards so lists arrive usable and compliant with the Privacy Act, Australian Privacy Principles and UK GDPR/PECR

CRM and integrations

  • Owning the health of our CRM (Attio), including object and field design, pipeline stages, data hygiene, deduplication, ownership rules and reporting views

  • Building and maintaining integrations between the CRM and the rest of the GTM stack, including our dialler (JustCall), scheduling (Calendly), billing (Stripe), analytics (Metabase and our product database) and marketing channels (Meta Ads, website forms)

  • Writing automations and scripts (Python or JavaScript, webhooks, Zapier/Make/n8n or direct API work) so leads, activities and revenue events land in the right place without anyone re-keying them

  • Querying our data warehouse and Metabase in SQL to report on pipeline, conversion, attribution and rep activity, and to reconcile CRM records against source-of-truth systems

  • Documenting how the stack fits together and training the team on the parts they touch

About you

  • 3 to 5 years in revenue operations, sales operations, growth engineering, data or a similar role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company

  • Proven experience building outreach or prospect lists with scraping and enrichment tools such as Clay

  • Strong CRM administration on at least one modern platform (Attio, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar), including data model design and hygiene rather than just day-to-day use

  • Solid SQL and comfort in a BI tool such as Metabase

  • Working proficiency in Python or JavaScript, plus experience with REST APIs, webhooks and automation platforms

  • Practical experience using LLMs and agentic tooling in real workflows, with a clear view of where they help and where they don't

  • A high bar for data quality and the discipline to keep systems tidy over time

  • Clear written communication, translating what sales and marketing need into systems that deliver it

  • Experience with accounting or legal firms, or professional body datasets in NZ, AU or the UK, is an advantage

  • Familiarity with marketing attribution and multi-touch pipeline analysis is an advantage

  • The right to work in the UK

What you'll get

  • No legacy stack to work around and no committee to get through. If you can show a better way of finding customers or running the CRM, you'll ship it

  • A small, well-funded team where the systems you build directly determine how well the company grows

How to apply

Alongside your CV, include a short note about one data or automation problem you've solved for a sales team and how you did it. Links to anything you've built (repos, Clay tables, dashboards, write-ups) are welcome.

The ideal candidate has a strong software and platform engineering background combined with significant experience operating within UK defence environments. Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie.

 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne.  Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

 

Sujet : « Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Renewable Energy Production and Storage in Subsurface Reservoirs”

Ce poste fait partie de la subvention « Leveraging AI for Sustainable Renewable Energy Production and Storage », financée par Hi ! Paris (https://www.hi-paris.fr/). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et impactant. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.

Le changement climatique exige des stratégies innovantes pour exploiter les énergies renouvelables. Le sous-sol de la Terre offre un potentiel important grâce à des technologies telles que l'énergie géothermique profonde, le stockage souterrain de l'hydrogène et le captage, l'utilisation et le stockage du carbone (CCUS). Ces méthodes pourraient transformer le paysage énergétique de la France et de l'Europe, mais elles sont souvent entravées par la sismicité induite par l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre.

Pour relever ce défi, il faut des solutions avancées. La théorie du contrôle mathématique, telle qu'explorée dans le projet INJECT du CER (https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771), offre des stratégies pour minimiser les risques sismiques tout en optimisant la production d'énergie. Par ailleurs, l'intelligence artificielle (IA), en particulier l'apprentissage par renforcement (AR), présente une approche transformatrice grâce à sa nature agnostique et orientée vers la performance. L'apprentissage par renforcement peut développer des politiques très efficaces pour la gestion des systèmes souterrains et sert de paradigme pour aborder des systèmes complexes avec des incertitudes et des contraintes similaires, débloquant ainsi des applications plus larges dans divers domaines. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez contacter : ----- class="Default" style="text-align:justify;">Missions / Activités principales :

En tant que post-doctorant, vous ferez progresser les méthodes d'intelligence artificielle pour relever les défis du monde réel en matière de contrôle des systèmes régis par des équations différentielles partielles (EDP) non linéaires et non lisses. Les objectifs clés comprennent le développement d'algorithmes RL robustes, stables et adaptables, qui peuvent améliorer les modèles prédictifs pour la sismicité induite, le contrôle et l'optimisation de la production.

Le poste met l'accent sur la recherche interdisciplinaire, en intégrant l'IA à la géomécanique et à la théorie du contrôle pour approfondir la compréhension scientifique de l'injection de fluides dans le sous-sol et de la mécanique des tremblements de terre. Les résultats contribueront à des avancées scientifiques de pointe ayant un impact sur les communautés universitaires et industrielles.

Missions / Activité annexe :

· Contribuer à toute activité du service en fonction des priorités retenues.

· Contribuer à la démarche Qualité, notamment via la rédaction et la mise à jour des procédures, le renseignement et le suivi des indicateurs

Contribuer à la démarche RSE de l’Ecole dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : CDD de 2 ans

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : dès que possible

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus Paris-Saclay, 828 boulevard des Maréchaux 91762 Palaiseau – Cedex

Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) mais également par les transports en commun

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 18 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  •        Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Les candidats retenus doivent posséder de solides compétences scientifiques et être très motivés. La maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit est obligatoire.

Les candidats effectueront des recherches, développeront des dispositifs et des outils expérimentaux et rédigeront des articles scientifiques en étroite collaboration avec le PI du projet, Pr. Ioannis Stefanou, et les membres du groupe INJECT.

jobs.description:
Ground Software Engineer - Core

Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Core team within Ground Platform. The team develops the core capabilities that support Loft's ground platform, improve development workflows, and ensure platform reliability. You'll help build shared services and tools that benefit software teams across Loft.

You'll work on backend services, workflow automation, AI tooling, and platform infrastructure, with a focus on observability and reliability. You'll also have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, helping investigate anomalies and supporting real-time incident response when needed.

If you're excited about improving how software is developed across Loft, contributing to key technical decisions, and building more reliable platform systems, we'd love to hear from you.


About this role:
  • Evaluate and implement new technologies and software patterns that propagate to the entire Loft's software stack
  • Lead the creation and evolution of Loft's AI tooling for development, review, and spacecraft anomaly investigation
  • Develop central ground platform functionalities such as workflow automation, microservice inter-communication, and metrics
  • Take responsibility for the reliability and performance of Loft's ground platform infrastructure, including message queues, CI/CD, and observability
  • Have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, occasionally helping investigate anomalies and supporting real‑time incident response when needed
  • Collaborate with software engineers and satellite operators from all over the company to support and foster consistent, maintainable, and performant software solutions

Must Haves:
  • Solid backend software development experience
  • Hands-on knowledge of deployment and Infrastructure as Code
  • Ability to define and maintain CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working with Kubernetes

Nice to Haves:
  • Python development, particularly with Django
  • Knowledge of GraphQL and Graphene
  • Experience with message queues and streaming technologies (NATS)
  • Knowledge of DevOps and observability tools (Helm, Terraform, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, etc)
  • Familiarity with AI tooling
  • Frontend development with Vue and Web Components

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences

At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Votre focus sera les leads entrants non identifiés dans notre CRM, en dehors des sociétés déjà connues de notre base de données. Vous aurez pour objectif de transformer ces opportunités en contrats clients.

2. Suivi des opportunités commerciales :

- Priorisation des opportunités les plus chaudes
- Participer aux réunions hebdomadaires de revue du pipeline
 
3. Collaboration interservices :

4. Développement de la connaissance marché :

- Proposer des initiatives pour améliorer la qualification des leads et les stratégies de vente sur ce segment de marché.

jobs.title: Product Ops IA / Product Manager Ops - (H/F)
jobs.description:
Product Ops IA / Product Manager Ops - (H/F)

Mindset

Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que l’IA ne transforme pas seulement les produits, mais aussi la façon de les concevoir, de les construire et de les faire évoluer. Discovery, delivery, coordination, documentation, pilotage : tout le Product Development Lifecycle est en train d’être réinventé.

La plupart des entreprises ont déjà démarré. Elles ont des POCs, des power users, des outils partout, parfois des gains individuels visibles. Mais elles peinent encore à transformer cette énergie en gain collectif, en nouveaux standards de travail et en performance durable.

C’est là qu’intervient l’AI Product Ops.

Pas pour agir comme théoricien, mais pour repenser concrètement les modes de fonctionnement produit-tech, designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, outiller les bons workflows, et faire de l’IA un levier d’efficience organisationnelle dans le delivery de produits digitaux.

Chez Thiga, nous ne nous arrêtons pas à la recommandation. Nous construisons avec nos clients. Nous testons, nous outillons, nous faisons adopter.

Le job

En immersion chez le client, tu interviens au cœur de l’organisation produit-tech pour refondre le Product Development Lifecycle avec l’IA.

Ton rôle : identifier où l’IA crée le plus de valeur, repenser les processus, faire émerger de nouveaux standards de travail, et construire les premiers outils, skills ou agents qui rendent cette transformation réelle.

Tu es à la fois :

  • un profil hands-on, capable de builder pour montrer l’exemple ;

  • un profil ops, capable de simplifier et fiabiliser les workflows ;

  • un profil change, capable d’embarquer les équipes dans de nouvelles pratiques ;

Concrètement, dans le cadre de tes missions, tu seras amené·e à

  • Auditer les processus de discovery, delivery et go-to-market pour identifier les frictions, les tâches à faible valeur, les dépendances inutiles et les opportunités de délégation à l’IA.

  • Reconcevoir des processus de travail plus simples, plus rapides et plus robustes, en intégrant nativement l’IA dans le fonctionnement des équipes.

  • Designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, en clarifiant les rôles, les responsabilités, les points de contrôle et les conditions de réussite.

  • Mettre en place les outils, standards et rituels nécessaires à une exécution plus fluide : documentation, pilotage, reporting, coordination, partage de connaissance, qualité d’exécution.

  • Builder toi-même des skills, assistants, automatisations ou agents simples adaptés au contexte client, pour outiller des usages concrets et immédiats.

  • Contribuer au product building de manière très opérationnelle, pour démontrer par la preuve ce que de nouveaux modes de travail rendent possible.

  • Former et accompagner les équipes produit, design, tech et métier dans l’adoption de nouvelles pratiques, de nouveaux outils et de nouveaux réflexes de travail.

  • Mesurer l’impact des évolutions mises en place et ajuster en continu ce qui doit l’être.

  • Aider les clients à éviter trois écueils fréquents : beaucoup d’énergie pour peu d’impact, des POCs qui ne scalent pas, et des gains individuels qui ne se traduisent jamais en gains système.

À quoi ressemble le succès dans ce rôle

Au bout de quelques mois chez un client, tu as contribué à faire émerger des résultats visibles et mesurables :

  • des workflows de discovery et de delivery revus, simplifiés et mieux maîtrisés ;

  • des usages IA prioritaires cadrés, outillés et réellement adoptés ;

  • plusieurs agents ou assistants internes en production d’usage ;

  • une baisse nette du temps passé sur les tâches à faible valeur ;

  • une amélioration tangible de la rapidité d’exécution et de l’efficience collective.

  • la satisfaction des équipes accompagnées ;

Ce que ce rôle n’est pas

Ce poste n’est pas fait pour toi si tu cherches principalement à faire :

  • du conseil hors sol, très conceptuel, sans opérationnalisation rapide ;

  • du portfolio management ;

  • de la gestion d’infrastructure ou de plateforme ;

  • de l’industrialisation technique à grande échelle ;

L’AI Product Ops n’est ni un PMO, ni un architecte de plateforme, ni un ML engineer. C’est un rôle à l’intersection de l’efficience organisationnelle, du build, et de la conduite du changement.

Qui es-tu ?

Tu as au moins 6 ans d’expérience, avec un parcours qui t’a donné une compréhension forte du fonctionnement réel des équipes produit-tech.

Développeur Nouveaux Projets (F/H/X)

Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des énergies renouvelables et vous connaissez bien le tissu économique et territorial de l’Est de la France ? Rejoignez Novar et devenez un acteur clé de la transition énergétique !

En tant que Développeur Nouveaux Projets, vous serez en première ligne pour identifier et sécuriser de nouveaux sites solaires et/ou de stockage en régions AURA et Bourgogne, tout en construisant des relations solides avec les acteurs locaux (collectivités, propriétaires fonciers, entreprises, partenaires). Grâce à votre sens du terrain et votre capacité à fédérer, vous participerez activement au développement de projets qui font sens pour le territoire et ses habitants.


Vos missions

·         Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire.

·         Construire et maintenir un réseau local solide, incluant partenaires, collectivités et apporteurs d’affaires.

·         Approcher les propriétaires fonciers, agriculteurs, collectivités et clients C&I afin de présenter Novar et ses solutions.

·         Préparer et présenter des réponses à des appels à projets.

·         Négocier et contractualiser les accords fonciers et commerciaux.

·         Assurer le suivi des opportunités jusqu’à leur concrétisation et leur passage en phase de développement.

·         Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des outils, process et connaissances internes liés au développement territorial.

Votre profil

·         Formation Bac+5 : école de commerce, master en aménagement du territoire, urbanisme ou droit rural.

·         Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans un rôle similaire (prospection foncière, développement ENR ou aménagement territorial).

·         Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de négociation.

·         Goût prononcé pour le terrain et le contact direct avec les acteurs locaux.

·         Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion de projets.

·         Motivation à évoluer dans un secteur porteur et en pleine transformation.

 

Ce que NOVAR vous offre

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ?

💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours.
🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance.
🌴 Une prime vacances.
🩺 Mutuelle famille financée à 50% 
🚗 Une voiture de fonction.
🏠 Un mode de travail flexible et hybride – dans nos bureaux modernes ou confortablement depuis chez vous.
📚 Des opportunités de développement professionnel dans le domaine du stockage d’énergie par batteries (BESS).
🏆 Un voyage collectif annuel avec l’ensemble du groupe Novar, une expérience inoubliable – travailler dur et célébrer ensemble.

À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. 

 

Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. 

 

Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain.

ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Autonomy team who really enjoys creating quality, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through design improvements, and prioritizing sound interfaces and architecture. We are not specifically looking for roboticists, but welcome any person with extensive production software experience who wants to work in a real-world robotics deployment. At our company, we specialise in developing tailored software solutions that enable our robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. 

This is a senior, hands-on software engineering role at the heart of cutting‑edge R&D, mission frameworks, autonomous behaviors, obstacle avoidance, path planning and the application of modern AI techniques. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.

 

Your Contributions
  • Contribute to the technical strategy and design for the autonomy software architecture, ensuring robots act transparently and reliably in complex environments
  • Lead and develop core robotics algorithms to expand our autonomous operational envelope in challenging conditions
  • Triage customer issues, recognize trends, and rapidly make our system more resilient to failures observed in the field.
  • Write, deploy, and maintain highly efficient C++ and Python software for the autonomy stack
  • Serve as a mentor and collaborator, participating in architecture group activities and guiding junior engineers on algorithm design and best practices
  • Evaluate cutting-edge algorithms and solutions to continuously push the boundaries of autonomous performance and system adaptability

    • Your Profile
  • University degree in engineering or science with a focus on computer science, electrical engineering or robotics
  • Proven track record of shipping software to the field and maintaining those solutions over time
  • Proven experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices
  • Strong contributor to technical strategy and mentoring of junior engineers
  • Strong understanding of autonomous systems, including: motion planning, state estimation, behaviour‑based control, path planning, mission planning & execution
  • Strong knowledge of Linux systems, middleware frameworks and interfacing complex modules up and down the software stack
  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset, working towards a goal and achieving outcomes
  • Excellent communication skills in English

    • Bonus Points
  • Hands-on experience with Reinforcement Learning (RL) and deployment of cutting-edge AI/ML models
  • Development of scalable and modular robot architectures with task execution frameworks such as Behavior Trees
  • Experience with ROS/ROS2
  • Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim
  • Interest in agentic engineering toolchains
  • Successfully managed strategic partnerships with external engineering companies
    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Systems Engineer (Excavator Automation)

Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

 

 

About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging.

We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role.

You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios, support atypical and beta deployments, and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities.

What you will do

  • Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions

  • Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits

  • Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level

  • Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments

  • Apply hotfixes when appropriate

  • Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers

  • Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers

  • Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design

  • Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact


    • What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience working with complex systems (automation, robotics, vehicles, heavy machinery, industrial equipment, or similar)

  • Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills

  • C++ and Python programming skills, proficiency in git systems

  • Proficiency in Linux systems

  • Comfortable working in field environments (construction sites, test yards, deployments)

  • Ability to travel abroad, according to needs of the business

  • Driver’s license B category


    • Beneficial

  • Experience with excavators, heavy equipment, or off-road vehicles

  • Field testing experience

  • Familiarity with communication technologies such as DDS, Zenoh, LCM etc.

  • Experience in motion planning or control

  • Experience in robotic competitions

    This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Developer

Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

  • The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

  • Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

  • The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

  • The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for

  • You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

  • You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

  • You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

  • You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

  • You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

  • You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

  • You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

  • English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out

  • You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

  • You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

  • You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

  • You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team

We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.

The facts

  • Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team

  • Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership

  • Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers

  • Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith

  • Pensum: 100%

  • Start: As soon as possible

  • Language: English; German a plus

  • Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls

How to apply

Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does.

Manager CTO Office

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein.

Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties.

Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie.

Sturing en beheersing
Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten.

Verandering en verbetering
Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur;

  • Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie;

  • Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst;

Natera's Oncology Pharma Marketing team is hiring a Lead Campaign Manager to own campaign strategy and execution end to end. You will report to the Director of Corporate Marketing, and work in close, high-trust partnership with the ONC Marketing VP and cross-functional leaders across creative, agency, and marketing operations.

The right person is able to work autonomously — someone who can build a campaign strategy from a business objective, defend it with data, and hold a professional line with senior stakeholders, including pushing back when the strategy, timeline, or resourcing calls for it.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Strategy & Execution

• Own ONC Pharma campaign strategy end to end — from translating business and brand objectives into an integrated, multi-channel campaign plan through launch, in-flight optimization, and retrospective.

• Direct day-to-day execution across channels (digital, email, paid media, content, HCP/patient-facing programs, events), making prioritization calls and tradeoffs as they arise.

• Set the campaign brief and creative direction in partnership with creative and brand teams, ensuring every asset ladders back to strategy.

• Proactively surface risks to timeline, budget, or performance and drive them to resolution — rather than escalating and waiting.

Performance Measurement & Optimization

• Define the KPIs and measurement framework for each campaign; monitor performance in flight rather than only in retrospective.

• Read measurement results critically — translate what happened into specific, actionable tweaks, tests, and recommendations for what to do next.

• Build a continuous test-and-learn discipline into every campaign cycle, and codify what's learned so it compounds across campaigns.

• Present performance results and strategic recommendations directly to senior stakeholders, including the ONC Marketing VP, with clear, well-substantiated rationale.

Cross-Functional & Agency Leadership

• Serve as the senior point of coordination across creative, agency and media partners and marketing operations.

• Drive alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities by facilitating decisions — not simply routing requests or escalating every conflict.

• Manage agency and vendor relationships, holding partners accountable to strategy, quality, and timeline, and redirecting work that misses the mark.

Executive Partnership — Managing Up

• Partner closely with the ONC Marketing VP as a strategic thought partner, bringing a well-reasoned point of view rather than waiting for direction.

• Hold the line on campaign strategy, scope, and prioritization decisions under pressure or scope creep, communicating disagreement professionally and constructively.

• Know when to resolve versus escalate, and when escalating, bring options and a recommendation rather than an open question.

• Give direct, constructive feedback up and across the organization, including to more senior stakeholders, in service of the campaign and the business.

Qualifications

Pharma, biopharma, oncology, or broader life sciences experience strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated fluency in reading and acting on performance data (e.g., analytics platforms, Power BI, Salesforce, Eloqua or similar marketing automation) — comfortable moving from “what happened” to “what we do about it.”

• Proven experience managing up to and influencing senior stakeholders, including situations requiring diplomatic pushback, boundary-setting, and holding a position under pressure.

• Strong cross-functional leadership skills — able to align creative, agency, and operations partners without formal authority over them.

Senior Technical & Data SEO Specialist

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces help patients find the right doctors and clinics they can trust, facilitating access to healthcare with a seamless experience.

About the team

We're the team behind the search visibility of 13 marketplaces in 13 countries (spread between Europe and South America), driving over 1 billion organic clicks and 2 billion total visits every year. We own the full scope of organic search-driven traffic — Technical SEO, Local SEO, Content, Data Analytics, and increasingly, AI Search and LLM visibility.

We test, build, execute, learn and iterate.

While we expand our focus on AI visibility and adopt AI-based solutions for internal processes, Technical SEO and Data Analytics are at the core of any search strategy.
We're therefore looking for an experienced Senior Specialist who can thrive in the Tech and Data area, and contribute to our LLMs visibility strategies.

The team currently consists of two Senior Search Traffic Acquisition Specialists and three engineers, reporting respectively to the Search Traffic Acquisition Manager and the Engineering Manager.

About the role

As a Senior Tech SEO & OS Data Analyst, you will

  • own Tech SEO maintenance and improvements in all our marketplaces

  • manage all the Data pipelines necessary for the proper analysis of our performance

  • confidently use AI to improve and automate processes, as well as contribute to influence LLMs visibility

People at Docplanner are experienced and curious, so you will also have the opportunity to explore other acquisition channels and apply AI-based automations and outputs to maximise Visibility through them.

You'll be exposed to many areas of Search in a highly dynamic environment, with real space to build, experiment, test, and learn.

Specifically, you will:

  • Guarantee a state-of-the-art Tech SEO compliance for our marketplaces — you know Tech SEO inside out, and you will navigate safely in massive URL name migrations, Structured Data refinement, Page Templates redesigns, Link Graphs, Indexability rules, Crawl efficiency, etc., collaborating smoothly with experienced engineers inside and outside the team.

  • Learn, manage, maintain, improve and build our Data pipelines, which currently cover several data streams from different sources (GSC API, SERP scrapers, Logs, GBP API, GA4, etc), working closely with Data Engineers in order to apply fixes, improve processes, connect to new APIs and build reports

  • Mine opportunities with AI — using AI-powered analysis to surface new traffic acquisition opportunities across markets, verticals, and channels that would be difficult to detect manually at our scale.

  • Report on impact — you will contribute to design an analytics framework to gauge the impact of our comprehensive visibility strategy.

What we're looking for

Expected:

  • 5+ years of experience in SEO, with a strong, hands-on Technical SEO background on large websites (up to 1 million+ URLs)

  • Strong knowledge of and experience with Python and SQL (other programming languages are a plus) for data analysis/tools orchestration/automation

  • Hands-on experience exploring AI/LLM visibility tactics, how generative AI is reshaping search behavior and what strategies can influence AI Search responses

  • Use of AI assistants and tools to increase the speed and quality of processes and deliveries related to Search channels

  • Solid understanding of SEO across all its branches: Technical, Content, Analytics, and Authority

  • Ability to work autonomously, manage internal and external stakeholders, and drive projects from idea to measurable impact

  • Proactivity — you spot opportunities before being asked to look for them

Nice to have:

  • Experience in Paid Search / Performance Marketing

  • App Store Optimization (ASO) experience

Why join us?

Visible impact – the strength and breadth of our brands and marketplaces ensures that our actions have a significant impact on Search visibility and patients experience.

A big yet agile corporation – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – no matter how the future of AI Search will look, we want to be at the forefront of it

What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Giorgio, Search Traffic Acquisition Manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣ Peer Interview – A conversation with at least one of the Senior Specialists of the team: our goal is to have a cohesive team delivering maximum impact within a supportive culture.

4️⃣ Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with Giorgio and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings. You will meet most of the team at this stage

5️⃣ Offer!

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

Benefits

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills.

  • Flexible remuneration and benefits system via Flexoh, which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings.

True flexibility and work-life balance

  • Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona.

  • Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly).

  • Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier).

  • 23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays.

  • Additional paid holiday on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

Health comes first

  • Private healthcare plan with Adeslas for you and subsidized for your family (medical and dental).

  • Access to hundreds of gyms for a symbolic fee in partnership for you and your family with Wellhub.

  • Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.

Keep growing with us

  • Free English and Spanish classes.

When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Sales Manager, Enterprise

Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

Reporting directly to our Head of UKI, Harvey's Enterprise Sales Manager for UKI will lead and coach high-performing Account Executives selling into corporate legal departments across UK and Ireland.   • Cultivate a culture of ownership, urgency, and development - attracting top sales talent and making fast, evidence-based personnel decisions when performance is off track.

  • Experience operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment where you built the motion - processes, cadences, and team — from a small base.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Financial Controller

What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

 

A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

 

Does this sound like you?

You’re a qualified accountant who enjoys being close to the numbers and close to the business. You’ve run month-end, the balance sheet, and financial controls end to end, and you know what good controls look like in both complex and fast-growing environments. You stay calm under pressure, explain finance simply to people outside it, and you’re always looking for smarter, more automated ways of working.

 

What you'll do

You’ll run Flagstone’s day-to-day core finance operations, making sure our numbers are accurate, controlled, and on time. Reporting to the Finance Director, you’ll own the month-end close, the balance sheet, and day-to-day financial control, while our FP&A team owns planning and forecasting. As the Finance Director’s right hand, you’ll run the detail so they can focus on supporting the CFO, the Board, and commercial decisions. It’s a hands-on role that will grow in scope and complexity as Flagstone scales.

This will include:

  • Running the month-end close end to end and delivering accurate, timely management accounts

  • Keeping a clean, fully supported balance sheet, with reconciliations, accruals, prepayments, and journals in order

  • Making sure direct-to-consumer and business revenue is recorded accurately, with commercial terms in contracts correctly reflected in revenue and cash

  • Managing daily cash and liquidity monitoring, so the Finance Director always has a clear view of our position

  • Owning financial controls that fit our scale and regulatory environment, including our obligations as an Authorised Payment Institution

  • Preparing for the annual statutory audit, and delivering VAT returns, tax compliance, Companies House filings, and HMRC reporting

  • Making sure monthly payroll and benefits are processed accurately, supported by clear standard operating procedures

  • Working closely with teams across the business, including Product and Engineering on software capitalisation, Compliance, People, Legal, Sales, Data, and Transaction Operations

  • Deputising for the Finance Director and supporting the team during peak periods

  • Using automation and AI to shorten the close, reduce manual work, and help build a technology-enabled finance function

 
 

What you'll bring

  • ACA or ACCA qualified, with solid post-qualified experience running month-end, balance sheet, and financial controls

  • Strong technical accounting knowledge and the pace to deliver to tight deadlines

  • Experience in a complex environment with good controls discipline, as well as in a smaller, fast-growing business

  • Experience with a modern cloud ERP system, with Workday Financials a significant advantage

  • A sharp eye for detail and good commercial awareness, spotting when numbers and contracts differ and following it through

  • Strong organisation, with the ability to manage competing priorities and adjust quickly

  • Clear, direct communication that builds trusted relationships across teams, and the ability to explain financial information simply to non-finance colleagues

  • An empathetic, approachable style, helping other teams get things right rather than just flagging what’s wrong

  • Resilience through month-end, audit, and shifting priorities, and the confidence to challenge constructively, including at senior level

  • Ownership of outcomes, sound judgement on when to act and when to escalate, and a drive to keep finding better ways of working

  • Direct-to-consumer experience is helpful but not essential

     

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Working Abroad - Flagstone employees can work remotely from an approved list of locations for up to 90 days a year

  • Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

  • Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.

     

All are welcome.

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

jobs.title: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01
jobs.description:
Shift Supervisor | DSL-01

Shift Supervisor | DSL-01

Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten.

 

Over de functie

Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie.

Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES.

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar):

  • Werk je in dagdienst

  • Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01

  • Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies

  • Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators

  • Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie

  • Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek.

In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028):

  • Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces.

  • Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta.

  • Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren.

 

Jouw profiel

SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

  • Ervaring en affiniteit met Procestechniek, Chemische Technologie of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Minimaal een afgeronde VAPRO C of AOT niveau 4-opleiding

  • Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de chemische, petrochemische, raffinage- of vergelijkbare procesindustrie

  • Aantoonbare operationele leidinggevende ervaring en bewezen people development skills

  • Ervaring met procesautomatisering en het werken met DCS- en MES-systemen

  • Kennis van procesveiligheid, werkvergunningensystemen en relevante wet- en regelgeving

  • Ervaring met het nemen van operationele beslissingen in situaties waar veiligheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit samenkomen

Welkome extra kennis en ervaring:

  • Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten

  • Ervaring met commissioning, startup en operational readiness

  • Kennis van raffinage-, hydroprocessing- of duurzame brandstofprocessen

  • Ervaring met continue verbeterprogramma's en performance management

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen wij aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Waarom deze rol?

Deze functie biedt een kans die maar weinig operators en shift supervisors krijgen. Je bent vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij de realisatie van een compleet nieuwe fabriek en kunt jouw operationele expertise inzetten om invloed uit te oefenen op commissioning, procedures, opleidingen en de uiteindelijke manier van werken.

Na de opstart maak je de stap naar een operationele omgeving waarin je leiding geeft aan een moderne productie-installatie en een belangrijke rol speelt in het neerzetten van de standaarden, cultuur en prestaties van de fabriek.

Tegelijkertijd draag je direct bij aan de realisatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken. Een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuwe productieorganisatie én een tastbare bijdrage te leveren aan de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

NB: Voor de opbouw van de operationele organisatie zoeken we uiteindelijk vijf Shift Supervisors. De eerste twee Supervisors starten tijdens de project- en opstartfase van DSL-01. De overige drie posities worden naar verwachting in het voorjaar ingevuld, zodat het volledige team gereed is voor de operationele fase. ‌

 

Solliciteer

Wil jij meewerken aan de succesvolle realisatie van een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart.

NB: Een medische keuring maakt vanwege veiligheids- en gezondheidsredenen onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure voor deze functie. ‌

 

Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com.

📌 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

SkyNRG is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken.

Compensation: €4,583 – €6,000 per month

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Program Manager

About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Join us as a Technical Program Manager in our new Project Management Office (PMO), reporting to the PMO Lead. You will own day-to-day program management for one to two development programs, keeping schedules, responsibilities and risks visible across development and production departments. Working in a highly technical, fast-moving environment, you will build the habits and practice of program discipline that the whole company will adopt as the PMO scales.

What you'll be doing

  • Ownership and responsibility

    • Own top level execution and delivery of assigned programs.

    • Partner with project and discipline leads on cross-department programs to ensure execution on schedule and within budget.

    • Manage the day-to-day execution of the assigned programs including handoffs across departments.

    • Lead the program-management activities for your assigned programs: schedule build, baselining, gate reviews, etc.

  • Manage uncertainty and risk

    • Identify risks and bottlenecks early

    • Plan for potential failure modes and contingencies

    • Escalate risks and blockers to the relevant stakeholders promptly.

  • Support growth and development of the team

    • Mentor junior program managers in program execution and collaborative leadership.

    • Support the PMO Lead in rolling out common language, product lifecycle, team rhythms for programs.

    • Support general program management training across the organization.

Your Profile

  • Leadership experience

    • Over 6 years of experience, including more than 4 years managing the delivery of complex, research-intensive chip hardware projects in a program management role.

    • Lead programs coordinating across functions and departments.

    • Proven ability to work with highly specialised technical experts.

    • Experience working in a fast-moving start-up or scale-up environment balancing hands-on technical leadership with growing a team, as a strong plus.

  • Approach

    • Learn quickly in a highly technical, low-maturity field, without needing a deep technical background in quantum computing on day one.

    • Translate a long-term strategy into an execution plan for your program teams.

    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to make pragmatic, informed decisions under uncertainty.

    • Bring together world-class technical experts and project leads to execute on highly complex programs.

  • Technical Background

    • MSc, PhD, or equivalent experience in physics, electrical engineering, microwave/RF engineering, semiconductor technology, or a related field.

    • Understanding of the development lifecycle for chip-level technologies; experience with superconducting qubits or cryogenic systems is a strong plus.

  • Communication

    • Excellent communicator who can motivate teams, facilitate alignment, adept at communicating program management ideas to highly technical people.

    • Collaborate with stakeholders and colleagues across the organization - Product, Research and Development, Operations, Management team, etc.

    • Communicate fluently in English.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.
