jobs.title: Coding Consultant Outpatient - PRN
jobs.description:
Coding Consultant Outpatient - PRN

Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

We’re looking for experienced and credentialed outpatient coders to become an integral part of our team. The ideal candidate for this role possesses high attention to detail and a depth of knowledge in medical terminology. This role is fully remote with a flexible schedule, allowing you to help shape the future of healthcare from your own workspace!

We are looking for the following experiences/skills:

  1. strong ED coder with 5+ years' experience. The ideal candidate will have experience in facility E/M leveling, injections/infusions, and bedside procedures. CCS Required and experience in EPIC and 3M/Solventum required as well.
  2. experienced Outpatient Same-Day Surgery/Observation (OP SDS/OBS) coder with a minimum of two years of relevant coding experience. A current CCS certification is required, along with experience using Epic and 3M. Experience reviewing and clearing coding edits would be helpful.
  3. ED/Ambulatory Surgical coder for Level III trauma facility for 15-20 hours/week. Required experience in facility ED E/M leveling, injections and infusions, ortho, urology, pain management, cardiology GI procedures, and endos. Interventional radiology a plus but not required.
  4. Observation coder with extensive injection and infusion experience. Academic or trauma level 1 experience preferred. Carving out experience preferred but not required. Surgery coding experience would be very helpful
  5. Outpatient Same-Day Surgery/Observation (OP SDS/OBS) with 3+ years of experience. Surgery expertise includes, but not limited to, General Surgery, Ortho, Plastics and Reconstruction, including breast reconstruction, revision, augmentation, mastectomy, Otolaryngology, Spinal fusions and injections, Cardiology including pacemakers, Transesophageal Echocardiogram, Interventional Radiology, OB/Gyne, Nephrology, Endoscopy, US guidance, and Robotic Procedures. Must be able to code both SDS and OBS and be familiar with Rev Code assignment for surgeries. No injections and infusions or OBS time carveouts. CCS required and experience with EPIC/3M required as well.
  6. Outpatient Coder with expertise in Emergency Department (ED), I&I, procedures, modifiers, and facility leveling coding. Minimum of 3+ years of outpatient coding with experience. Experience with Epic and Clintegrity strongly preferred.
  7. Outpatient Claim Edits coder. A minimum of 3 years of experience with Hospital Billing(HB) Claim edits is a requirement. Experience with Parallon, Cerner, and Optum would benefit a candidate in this role. Additionally, experience with use of Microsoft Office suite, primarily excel is a plus.

What You Will Do:

  • Review medical records and assign accurate codes for diagnoses and procedures.
  • Assign and sequence codes accurately based on medical record documentation.
  • Assign the appropriate discharge disposition.
  • Abstract and enter the coded data for hospital statistical and reporting requirements.
  • Communicate documentation improvement opportunities and coding issues to appropriate personnel for follow up and resolution.

  • Demonstrate initiative and judgment in the performance of job responsibilities.
  • Communicate with co-workers, management, and hospital staff regarding clinical and reimbursement issues.
  • Function in a professional, efficient, and positive manner.
  • Adhere to the American Health Information Management Association’s code of ethics.
  • Be customer-service focused and exhibit professionalism, flexibility, dependability, and a desire to learn.
  • Handle a high complexity of work function and decision-making.
  • Possess strong organizational and teamwork skills.
  • Comply with all HIM Division Policies.

What You Need to Succeed:

  • AHIMA certified credentials (RHIA, RHIT, CCS) or AAPC certified credentials (CPC, CPC-H, COC, CIC or CRC).
  • 2+ years of coding experience in a hospital and/or coding consulting role.
  • Proficiency with most or all of these coding specialties (Same Day Surgery, Observation, Injections/Infusions)
  • Proficiency with most or all of these coding specialties (Ancillary, Emergency Department, Injections/Infusions, E/M leveling)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, adeptness in remote work, and exceptional time management skills.
  • Experience in computerized encoding and abstracting software.

  • Experience in computerized encoding and abstracting software

What We Offer:

  • Benefits for PRN employees: 401k savings plan w/match

jobs.title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
jobs.description:
Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification

Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

Role Overview

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

  • You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.

  • You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

  • You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

  • Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

  • You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 

What we expect from you

  • Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

  • Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

  • Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line.

  • Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

  • Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

  • Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

  • Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

  • Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

  • Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 

What we look for

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

  • A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.

  • Strong understanding of finance processes, ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes.

  • Hands on with AI. You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you.

  • You set baselines, name owners, hit deadlines, and say so early when something slips.

  • You can lead a small team and still do the work yourself.

  • You prioritise by impact and move fast. Better done than perfect.

  • You bring finance, tech and operations along with you.

  • Fluent in English. Czech is not required, but is an advantage.

 

What’s in it for you

  • Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary — no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly.

  • Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work.

  • Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility – three days in the office, 2 days Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.

  • Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.

  • Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live — from day one.

  • Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.

  • Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik.cz.

  • Sport & wellbeing - You’ll stay active with company sports challenges or a subsidised Multisport card.

  • A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together.

  • If this sounds like you…You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us?

jobs.title: Business Analyst (gn)
jobs.description:
Business Analyst (gn)

Festanstellung bei New Monday · Vollzeit · überwiegend remote innerhalb Deutschlands · gelegentliche Teamtreffen in Essen · Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

Du verstehst komplexe Prozesse, bringst Struktur in Anforderungen und entwickelst daraus konkrete Lösungen? Bei New Monday suchen wir zwei Business Analyst für ein Kundenprojekt, das eine zentrale Herausforderung der Energiewende adressiert: den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen.

Im Projekt entsteht ein Netzanschlusssystem mit drei miteinander verbundenen Anwendungen: einem Kundenfrontend, einem Installateursfrontend und einer Sachbearbeiterlösung. Gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams gestaltest du die fachlichen Grundlagen dafür, die durchgängigen Prozesse effizienter zu machen.

Über New Monday

Wir sind New Monday und begleiten Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte – von der ersten Idee über die Analyse und Konzeption bis hin zu Design und technischer Umsetzung. Dafür bringen wir Kompetenzen aus Business Analyse, UX/UI Design und Softwareentwicklung zusammen.

Als Teil von New Monday bringst du deine Expertise direkt in die Projekte unserer Kunden ein. Dort arbeitest du in der Regel als Mitglied des Kundenteams eng mit den jeweiligen Fachbereichen, Product Ownern und Entwicklungsteams zusammen. Du machst komplexe Anforderungen verständlich, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und gestaltest Lösungen, die Nutzer und Unternehmen weiterhelfen.

Dein berufliches Zuhause bleibt New Monday: Wir begleiten dich während deines Projekteinsatzes, unterstützen deine Weiterentwicklung und schaffen Raum für fachlichen Austausch und persönliche Begegnungen im Team.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst und strukturierst prozessuale Anforderungen und entwickelst fachliche sowie technische Umsetzungskonzepte.

  • Du übersetzt fachliche Bedarfe in klare, umsetzungsreife Spezifikationen als Grundlage für die technische Realisierung.

  • Du arbeitest dich in komplexe Systemlandschaften und ihre Prozesse ein, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und dokumentierst konkrete Handlungsbedarfe.

  • Du bearbeitest definierte Testpakete, führst Reviews durch und analysierst auftretende Fehler. Dabei dokumentierst und bewertest du Fehlerbilder aus fachlicher Sicht.

  • Du erarbeitest Lösungsoptionen und Handlungsempfehlungen und stimmst diese mit angrenzenden Rollen und Fachbereichen ab.

  • Du behältst den gesamten Prozess über die drei Anwendungen hinweg im Blick und hilfst dabei, den Nutzen der Lösung kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Was du mitbringst

  • Erfahrung in der Business Analyse oder im Requirements Engineering für komplexe IT-Projekte.

  • Die Fähigkeit, fachliche und prozessuale Anforderungen systematisch aufzunehmen, zu hinterfragen und verständlich zu dokumentieren.

  • Technisches Verständnis, um Zusammenhänge, Abhängigkeiten und Schnittstellen innerhalb einer Systemlandschaft zu analysieren.

  • Erfahrung mit der Erstellung von Spezifikationen und Umsetzungskonzepten sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams.

  • Erfahrung mit fachlichen Tests, Reviews und der Analyse und Bewertung von Fehlern.

  • Eine strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Teamtreffen in Essen.

Das erwartet dich bei New Monday

  • Flexibles Arbeiten passend zum Projekt: In diesem Projekt arbeitest du überwiegend remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Gelegentliche Teamtreffen finden vor Ort in Essen statt.

  • Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du organisierst deine Arbeit eigenständig und stimmst dich dabei mit deinem Kundenteam ab. Bei New Monday setzen wir auf kurze Abstimmungswege und Vertrauen.

  • Aufgaben mit Wirkung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung direkt im Kundenprojekt ein und gestaltest digitale Prozesse mit, die den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen unterstützen.

  • Persönliche Begleitung im Projekteinsatz: Auch wenn dein Arbeitsalltag überwiegend im Kundenteam stattfindet, bleiben wir mit dir im Austausch und begleiten dich bei Fragen, Herausforderungen und deiner Entwicklung.

  • Ein Team, das sich auch persönlich trifft: Neben dem digitalen Austausch schaffen wir bewusst Raum für regionale Treffen und gemeinsames Coworking. Ein- bis zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte New-Monday-Team zusammen.

  • Zeit und Budget für deine Entwicklung: Wir fördern fachliche Weiterbildung und den Austausch im Team. Nach der Probezeit steht dir dafür ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € zur Verfügung.

  • Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Wir arbeiten aktuell an einem Karriereentwicklungsplan, der Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und nächste Schritte bei New Monday transparenter machen soll. Deine eigenen Ziele und Interessen besprechen wir regelmäßig mit dir.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzlich zwei Tage für unsere Team-Events.

So geht es weiter

  • Erstes Kennenlernen: Wir erzählen dir mehr über New Monday, die Rolle und das Kundenprojekt. Du berichtest uns von deiner Erfahrung und kannst alle Fragen stellen, die dir wichtig sind.

  • Vertiefender Austausch: Wir sprechen ausführlicher über deine bisherigen Projekte, deine Arbeitsweise und deine Erfahrung in der Business Analyse und im Requirements Engineering.

  • Kennenlernen im Kundenprojekt: Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, stellen wir dich beim Kunden vor. Dort lernst du das Projektumfeld und die beteiligten Ansprechpartner kennen. Die weiteren Schritte stimmen wir transparent mit dir ab.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – auch wenn du nicht jede Anforderung vollständig erfüllst!

New Monday fördert die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung unter Berücksichtigung der Umstände des Einzelfalls bevorzugt.

Dein Einstieg

Die Stelle ist auf 12 Monate befristet, umfasst 40 Stunden pro Woche und sieht eine Probezeit von 6 Monaten vor. Wenn du dich in den Anforderungen wiederfindest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über die Plattform.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist/ML Ops Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior Data Scientist/ML Ops Engineer (all genders)

Responsibilities

With a mission to empower 15.6 million house owners across Germany and the broader DACH region, we at Aroundhome are building a platform where every strategic decision is powered by data. We’re a team of around 250 people, and to take the next step, we’re looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Data Scientist (all genders) to bring machine learning into the heart of our product.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will build Aroundhome’s first machine learning model in production: the logic that decides which partners each homeowner is matched with. You will start from the problems homeowners and partners actually have, and own the solution end to end, in a small new team with a product manager, an engineer and the team lead.

Responsibilities:

  • Start from the Customer: Understand what homeowners and partners need from a match, and turn that into the outcomes and guardrails your models optimize for, not just model metrics.
  • Own Our Matching Models: Build and run the models behind our partner matching, end to end: data, features, training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring.
  • Make Every Match Count: Improve our matching logic with deployed models that make the most efficient use of partner capacity, raise match rates, and account for regional supply and demand.
  • Prove Impact: Measure every improvement against our current logic in controlled experiments designed for a two-sided marketplace, before it scales.
  • Build the Data Foundation: Create the datasets and pipelines your models need, together with our engineer and the Data Engineering team. In the first months, this is a big part of the role.
  • Shape Our ML Stack: Decide with the team how and where models run, and set the practices for machine learning at Aroundhome.
  • Translate Models into Decisions: Explain trade-offs between customer experience, partner fulfillment and revenue to product managers, partner category managers, key account managers and senior leadership.

Skills

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics).
  • Proven experience (5+ years) in applied data science, including at least one ads, ranking, pricing or marketplace model you took to production.
  • Production-grade Python and advanced SQL, plus hands-on experience with modern data tooling (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Spark).
  • Experience deploying and monitoring models on a cloud ML platform (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow).
  • Solid foundation in experiment design and causal inference, ideally in a marketplace where test and control groups affect each other.
  • Hands-on experience with classical machine learning (e.g., gradient-boosted trees), probability calibration and offline vs online evaluation.
  • A product mindset: you define success in homeowner and partner outcomes, challenge assumptions with evidence, and add complexity only where it earns its place.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain models and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A plus: experience with recommender systems or search ranking.

What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: Decide freely whether you want to work from our office in Berlin, from home throughout Germany, or fully remote from Portugal. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer monthly Tech Talks, an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner “Fürstenberg Institute” is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness for environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month at our Potsdamer Platz office, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

Principal of backend
jobs.description:
Principal of backend About SchemeServe

SchemeServe is insurance software like no other.

Hosted in the cloud for MGAs, brokers and insurers, the SchemeServe platform boasts unique flexibility, unstoppable innovation and truly Obsessive Support.

Started in 2000 by our CEO, Adam, SchemeServe has grown from strength to strength, never having taken outside investment. We're proud of how far we've come and how loyal we've stayed to our Core Values.

We're fully remote (we were doing it before it was fashionable!), although we get together twice a year for Team Retreats.

We prize self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and challenging themselves. Free books? Mentoring? Professional development? You got it.

We also offer flexible working, paid charity days, a fantastic, relaxed and open company culture and free biscuits through the post.

We genuinely believe this is the best place you could ever work.

If you're excited, good! So are we.

Come and join the Insurtech revolution!

Principal Backend Engineer

UK Remote

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.

You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.

But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.

Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software.

You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.

What We Mean By Principal



This is a deeply technical role.

You'll need the depth to understand complex backend systems, architecture, security, performance, resilience and maintainability; review designs and implementations; spot risks; and challenge experienced engineers.

But technical knowledge alone isn't enough.

We want someone who understands there isn't always one "correct" way to build software.

Patterns, standards and best practices are useful tools. They aren't commandments.

We care about finding the most appropriate solution to the problem in front of us.

That means understanding the problem, business, existing platform, risks and likely future – and making pragmatic decisions based on the trade-offs.

Sometimes the right answer will be a new service or technology.

Sometimes it'll be improving what we already have.

Sometimes the boring solution really is the best solution.

We're quite comfortable with that.

How You'll Lead



Success in this role comes through influence rather than authority.

We don't want every difficult technical decision to end with:

"We'd better ask the Principal Engineer."

If an engineer proposes an approach you disagree with, we don't just want you to replace it with your own.

Understand their thinking. Ask questions. Challenge assumptions. Explore the trade-offs. Share your experience.

And be prepared to change your own mind too.

The goal is to leave that engineer better equipped to solve the next problem, not just holding the answer to this one.

Your technical impact should multiply through the people around you.

You'll remain close enough to the code to understand what's actually happening and occasionally roll up your sleeves to prototype, investigate a difficult problem or unblock a team.

But if after a year you've personally written loads of brilliant software while everyone around you is working exactly as they were before, we haven't succeeded.

The Technical Challenge



Our platform has been evolving for more than 25 years.

At its heart is a mature C# .NET Framework 4.7 monolith, alongside an expanding ecosystem of modern C# .NET 10 and TypeScript services.

Our backend estate includes:


  • .NET Framework and modern C#/.NET.
  • TypeScript services.
  • Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Redis.
  • Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Cloudflare platform services.
  • API-first architecture.
  • Git-based development workflows.


We're continuing to modernise, but we're not interested in modernisation for modernisation's sake.

We aren't trying to win an award for having the most fashionable architecture diagram.

We want a secure, reliable and maintainable platform that can support SchemeServe for many years to come – and we want you to help us decide what should evolve and, just as importantly, what doesn't need changing.

What You'll Do



You'll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to:


  • Shape our backend engineering strategy, architecture and technical direction.
  • Help engineers make better technical and architectural decisions.
  • Develop sensible engineering principles and guardrails without replacing good judgement with rules.
  • Guide the continued evolution of our monolith and modern service-based platform.
  • Coach and mentor engineers, developing their technical skills and judgement.
  • Review significant designs and architectural decisions and challenge unnecessary complexity.
  • Champion security, quality, testing, observability, resilience and performance.
  • Identify technical risks and help teams navigate them.
  • Evaluate technologies and patterns based on their value to SchemeServe rather than their popularity elsewhere.
  • Balance long-term engineering quality with short-term business needs.
  • Occasionally contribute directly to implementation when that's genuinely the best way to help.
  • Be a generally awesome person.


What We're Looking For



You'll need:


  • Deep expertise in modern backend engineering and strong commercial C#/.NET experience.
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems and API design.
  • Experience with mature legacy applications and modern service-oriented architectures.
  • Strong cloud architecture experience, ideally Azure.
  • Excellent understanding of databases, security, testing, maintainability and modern software delivery.
  • Experience shaping engineering principles and practices across teams.
  • A track record of making engineers around you better through mentoring, coaching and technical leadership.
  • The ability to challenge experienced engineers constructively without becoming a gatekeeper.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held – the confidence to challenge and the humility to change your mind.
  • Excellent communication and the ability to influence without relying on authority.
  • Excellent technical judgement, balancing quality, complexity, risk, cost and business value.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who asks:

"What's the right solution for us?"

rather than:

"What's the way everyone else is doing it?"

Nice To Have


  • Experience modernising large monolithic applications.
  • Commercial TypeScript backend experience.
  • Cloudflare or edge technology experience.
  • SaaS platforms at scale.
  • Financial services, insurance or another regulated industry.
  • Observability, platform engineering or SRE experience.
  • AI-assisted development and engineering productivity tooling.


You don't need to tick every box.

If you've got the technical depth, judgement and ability to make engineers around you better, we'd rather have a conversation than lose a great candidate because you haven't used one particular technology.

What Success Looks Like



Within your first year:


  • Engineers are making stronger technical and architectural decisions with greater confidence.
  • Our engineering principles are understood rather than blindly followed.
  • Technical discussions are constructive, pragmatic and result in clear decisions.
  • Security, reliability, maintainability and performance concerns are identified earlier.
  • We've made sensible progress modernising our platform without adding complexity for complexity's sake.
  • You've made a lasting positive impact on both our software and the people who build it.


Ultimately, we don't want SchemeServe to become dependent on you for every difficult technical decision.

We want SchemeServe to become better at making those decisions because you're here.

Why Join SchemeServe?


  • Fully remote UK-based role.
  • Twice-yearly company retreats.
  • Flexible working.
  • Dedicated professional development support.
  • Paid charity days.


  • Friendly, supportiv...

Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description:
Member of Technical Staff

About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Product Engineer owns the surfaces people actually work in. A coordinator planning a month of inspections across a fleet of auditors. A reviewer signing off on a technical file. These are dense, stateful workflows where the interface carries real consequences, and where the person using it has done the job for twenty years and will know immediately if the software doesn't understand it.

You own product surface end to end: the interface, the backend that supports it, and the data model underneath. Every customer runs the work differently, so there's no template to fall back on. You decide what the right thing to build is, build it, and are the one who hears about it when it's wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about raw engineering strength than about matching a list of technologies. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, C++ or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, speed and standards are not.

What we're actually screening for:

  • You've built something hard and put it in front of real users. Not a prototype, not a course project. Something that ran, broke, and got fixed.

  • You build genuinely good interfaces, and you can go as deep on the backend as the feature requires.

  • You can hold a complicated workflow in your head and find the version of it that's simple enough to ship.

  • Speed with taste. You ship fast, and you're opinionated about what not to build.

  • You go to the source. You'll read the customer's actual documents, join the actual call, and look at hundreds of real outputs.

Signals we like, none of them required:

founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, early engineer at a startup with a serious engineering culture, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup, design sense you can defend, open source you genuinely maintain.

This is probably not for you if

  • You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

  • You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

  • You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get

  • Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

  • Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

  • Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

  • Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

  • A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce

Build, Scale & Operate Leading DTC Brands alongside A-Players

Maneuver Marketing

Our Vision, Mission & Success are fuelled by our commitment to be a driving force of positive change to the health of everyday consumers, providing conscious, high-quality & innovative supplement products.

In just 5 years, we kicked off our own DTC Health & Wellness brand from scratch and scaled it to USD$100M+ in annual sales, serving more than 3,000,000 customers worldwide with an average of 4,000 daily orders across 9 SKUs.

These results caught the attention of The Financial Times, as they ranked us among APACs top High-Growth Companies. We have also been awarded 2nd place on the E50 Awards, jointly organised by The Business Times and KPMG in Singapore.

This is just the beginning of our journey, and you could be part of the next stage of our growth!

Your Next Role

We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded and highly organized Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce to lead and scale our creator marketing capability.

You will own the end-to-end creator strategy and drive implementation for two women’s health brands. One brand offers supplements that help with symptoms and root causes, and the other offers supplements that support one’s lifestyle habits and addresses nutritional gaps.

Leading a team of two associates who execute the seeding program, you will upgrade and refine our current strategy to build a reliable community of high-quality creator partnerships that strengthen our organic presence, generate commercially valuable content and support our paid media performance.

This is a hands-on management role. You will set the strategy and performance targets, develop the team, improve our systems and processes, and remain directly involved in high-value partnerships and campaign decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong creator marketing instincts with operational discipline, commercial judgment and a clear understanding of how creator content can be transformed into effective paid advertising.

What You’ll Do

1. Own the Creator Strategy Across Both Brands

  • Own creator strategy for two women's health brands across two distinct motions: an established seeding program producing content at volume, and a new TikTok Shop affiliate program built for direct sales.

  • Scope is deliberately asymmetric. Seeding covers 4 flagship SKUs today, expanding to all 6 once the team's agentic workflows free the capacity. TikTok Shop launches focused on 2 products under one brand.

  • Build creator-driven demand that shows up beyond the platform it originates on: branded search volume, Amazon and Shopify sales lift, and a content library that feeds paid media.

  • Identify the right mix of healthcare professionals and content creators for each campaign.

  • Establish measurable targets across outreach volume, response rates, partnership approvals, content delivery, cost efficiency and campaign performance.

  • Monitor competitor activity, creator pricing and emerging platform trends to keep our approach relevant and competitive.

  • Build and deploy AI workflows that increase the team's throughput - creator qualification, outreach personalization at volume, content tagging and rights tracking. We expect measurable capacity gains, not experimentation.

2. Lead and Develop the Creator Marketing Team

  • The Meta seeding program is built and running at scale. Your associates own the day-to-day operations; your job is to consult with creative leads, sharpen briefs, run creative tests, and hold quality while the majority of your own attention goes to TikTok and affiliates.

  • Oversee the team’s day-to-day outreach, follow-ups, creator communication, fulfilment coordination and administrative workflows.

  • Build clear processes and operating rhythms that allow the team to manage a high volume of influencer activity accurately and efficiently.

3. Build a Scalable Creator Acquisition Pipeline

  • Source creators across three routes: direct outreach, the TikTok Shop affiliate marketplace, and the established creator network available through our TikTok consultant. Convert the consultant's network into signed, producing partnerships rather than a list.

  • Sustain the current output of hundreds of pieces of creator content per month across the seeding program, while building a separate affiliate creator pipeline for TikTok Shop.

  • Assess potential partners based on audience fit, content quality, engagement, credibility, pricing and their ability to create or follow relevant trends.

  • Develop partnerships with a strong focus on micro- and mid-sized creators, while selectively pursuing larger influencers when commercially justified.

  • Create tailored outreach strategies for a competitive market in which larger brands may offer significantly higher creator fees.

4. Build the TikTok Shop Affiliate Program

  • Own the TikTok Shop affiliate program for 2 products under one brand, from creator recruitment through commission structure, sample logistics and GMV performance.

  • Set and manage commission tiers, open collaborations, targeted invites and any performance-based arrangements; decide where flat-fee and where commission-only makes sense.

  • Own affiliate GMV as a number you're accountable for, and the unit economics behind it: cost per acquired affiliate, sample cost per producing creator, blended commission rate.

  • Identify and develop the small number of affiliates who will drive the majority of GMV, and build repeat and exclusive arrangements with them.

  • Work with the TikTok Affiliate Creative Strategist on creative direction. They own research, concept and brief content; you own creator supply, terms, relationship and program performance.

5. Own Campaign Execution and Creator Relationships

  • Oversee partnerships from initial outreach and qualification through contracting, product delivery, content production, payment and performance review.

  • Ensure creators receive clear briefs, campaign expectations, timelines and feedback.

  • Build strong, professional relationships that encourage creators to become long-term brand advocates rather than one-off partners.

  • Maintain an active and engaged creator community through regular updates, challenges, educational content and brand communications.

  • Own claims compliance in creator content across both brands. Maintain the do-say/don't-say guidance creators work from, and make sure it holds at volume across seeding, affiliate and organic.

  • Ensure FTC material-connection disclosure and platform-specific policy compliance on every partnership. TikTok Shop enforces supplement claims differently from Meta; both need to be handled correctly.

6. Turn Creator Content into Growth Assets

  • Secure usage rights and TikTok ad authorization (Spark Ad codes) at the point of partnership, not retroactively.

  • Establish a clear process for reviewing, categorizing and distributing creator-generated content.

  • Evaluate content based on brand alignment, creative quality, audience relevance and potential commercial use.

  • Work with Paid Media, Creative and Marketplace to route creator content to its highest-value use: paid social, marketplace listings, email and brand channels.

  • Translate both organic and paid media learnings back into creator briefs so creators can produce stronger, more testable content.

  • Supply the brand social channels with a steady flow of approved, on-brand creator content. Publishing and community management on brand-owned accounts sit with a separate role.

7. Own Tools, Vendors and Operational Excellence

  • Manage our external partners - the TikTok consultant and content agencies - including scope, output quality, cost and the decision on when capability should move in-house.

  • Own the influencer marketing stack end to end. We currently run SARAL; assess whether it, Modash, Lefty or an alternative best serves discovery, outreach, relationship management and reporting at our volume.

  • Partner with Supply and Operations teams to ensure product kits are shipped accurately and on time.

  • Oversee creator invoicing and payment workflows, ensuring submissions are accurate, approved and processed promptly.

  • Identify bottlenecks and introduce scalable workflows, automation and documentation where appropriate.

7. Measure and Improve Performance

  • You'll be measured on four things: TikTok Shop affiliate GMV, cost per usable content asset, branded search and marketplace lift attributable to creator activity, and content throughput against quality standard. Everything else is diagnostic.

  • You'll manage a defined creator and sampling budget across both programs, with authority to reallocate between seeding and affiliate based on returns.

  • Define and monitor the KPIs required to evaluate the health and commercial impact of the influencer program.

  • Track outreach volume, open and response rates, approval rates, creator acquisition costs, content delivery, engagement, reach, conversions and return on investment.

  • Build clear weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting for the Growth team and company leadership.

  • Analyze performance by creator profile, product, platform, partnership structure, outreach message and content format.

  • Maintain a structured testing roadmap covering outreach messages, incentives, creator segments and content approaches.

How You’ll Succeed

  • You combine strategic thinking with a willingness to remain close to execution.

  • You create clarity for your team, hold people accountable and help them improve.

  • You build a predictable pipeline of relevant creators and commercially valuable content.

  • You use data and experimentation to improve response rates, partnership quality and return on investment.

  • You can recognize creators who offer strong value beyond follower count alone.

  • You build effective partnerships across Creator Marketing, Paid Media, Creative, Supply, Email Marketing and E-commerce.

  • You introduce structure without slowing down execution.

  • You communicate clearly, act quickly and resolve problems before they affect campaigns.

  • You remain resourceful in a competitive market where budgets and creator expectations may not always align.

  • You care equally about relationship quality, operational accuracy and commercial outcomes.

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships or creator affiliate marketing, including at least one program you owned end to end with commercial accountability.

  • Operator experience running a TikTok Shop or comparable creator affiliate program, with GMV or revenue you were personally accountable for.

  • DTC or e-commerce experience in health and wellness, beauty, or another regulated consumer category.

  • Experience managing or mentoring team members, with evidence you raised their output rather than just reviewed it.

  • Experience managing external agencies, consultants or vendors: setting scope, holding quality, deciding when to bring work in-house.

  • Experience structuring and negotiating both flat-fee and performance-based partnerships.

  • Strong analytical skills and a track record of using campaign data to change decisions, not just report them.

  • Evidence of an AI or automation workflow you built or deployed that measurably increased throughput. Be ready to walk through what it does and what it saved.

Strongly preferred

  • Ownership of brand-owned organic social channels, not only creator programs. You understand how owned content and creator content compound.

  • Working knowledge of FTC material-connection disclosure and platform claim policy in a regulated category. You know what a creator cannot say about a supplement, and why the answer differs on TikTok and Meta.

  • Experience collaborating with Paid Media or Creative to repurpose creator content into performance advertising, including securing ad authorization at partnership time.

  • Hands-on with an influencer marketing platform - SARAL, Modash, Lefty or equivalent.

  • Experience running influencer or creator programs across multiple brands or product categories.

  • Experience partnering with healthcare professionals or subject-matter experts as brand partners.

  • Understanding of paid social creative testing and direct-response fundamentals.

  • Genuine interest in health, wellness, consumer behavior and social media culture.

Applied AI Engineer, AI for Mistral

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an Applied AI Engineer, your mission is to make Mistral AI-native from the inside. You lead the design and delivery of production-grade AI systems in rapid cycles, building the iconic use case for multiple department (eg: GTM, HR, Engineering, Finance, ect) in your portfolio. You sit where product, engineering and the business overlap, turning advanced technology into real-world solutions that move a metric.

You translate complex, often ambiguous business requirements into engineered solutions that work at scale. You act as the technical lead for your departments and contribute as an Individual contributor you guide the technical choices, build the solution end to end, drive adoption, and keep improving it. Your goal is to build clients trust, and deliver high ROI solutions, not a hit-and-run POC.

What You Will Do

  • Run discovery with department heads and key users, map their workflows, and turn ambiguous needs into a prioritized use-case backlog with clear expected value.

  • Deliver end to end: design and ship production-grade full-stack apps (Python/FastAPI, React) and AI systems, from scoping through deployment and adoption.

  • Encode business rules, KPIs and ROI metrics as durable datalake assets and app logic, so your departments run on trustworthy, observable data.

  • Dogfood the latest Mistral products as a first internal user, and turn what you learn into credible product feedback that shapes the roadmap.

  • Own architecture for your surface: keep it scalable, secure and observable, with a high bar on clean code.

  • Spot patterns across departments and lift one-off solutions into reusable building blocks.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 3 years building and deploying production AI software.

  • Strong full-stack engineer: Python/TypeScript, scalable backends (FastAPI/Node), and enough frontend (React/Vue) to ship a usable app yourself.

  • Hands-on with modern GenAI use cases: RAG, agents, workflows, orchestration and evaluation.

  • Strong command of vibe-coding tools, paired with genuine care for clean code and architecture: speed without slop.

  • Strong ownership and a bias for delivery. This is made for high-velocity engineers who already have experience.

  • Fluent in AI-native tools (Slack, Linear, etc.).

  • Passionate about solving customer problems. Here, your customers are Mistral's own teams.

  • Excellent communication in fluent English: you can explain a technical idea to a lawyer, a marketer and a staff engineer in the same afternoon.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to Legal, Public Affairs, Marketing or Compute/Infra domains, or a track record of getting fluent in an unfamiliar domain fast.

  • Data engineering or analytics experience (warehouse modeling, dbt, dashboards).

  • Contributions to open-source projects, especially around LLMs.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager – Secteur public
jobs.description:
Senior Customer Success Manager – Secteur public

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer.

Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Customer Success

L'équipe Customer Success accompagne les établissements de santé dans l'adoption et l'utilisation de nos solutions, avec un objectif : faire en sorte que nos produits soient pleinement intégrés dans les pratiques des professionnels de santé et génèrent un impact concret et durable.

Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Senior Customer Success Manager pour prendre la responsabilité d'un portefeuille d'établissements publics, comprenant des comptes stratégiques aux organisations et aux enjeux complexes.

Ce poste va au-delà du suivi opérationnel ou de la gestion de la relation client.

Tu seras responsable de définir et de piloter une véritable stratégie d'accompagnement, en tenant compte des enjeux spécifiques de chaque établissement, de leur maturité, de leurs usages et des différents interlocuteurs impliqués.

Ton rôle sera autant stratégique qu'opérationnel : comprendre les organisations de tes clients, identifier leurs enjeux à court et long terme, proposer des recommandations adaptées et mobiliser les bons leviers pour maximiser la valeur qu'ils retirent de nos solutions.

Ce n'est pas un rôle d'Account Manager centré sur la négociation commerciale, le renouvellement ou l'upsell. Ce n'est pas non plus un poste de support ou de déploiement technique. Tu interviens principalement une fois les solutions déployées, pour développer leur adoption, faire évoluer les usages et assurer la réussite de tes clients sur le long terme.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Piloter stratégiquement ton portefeuille clients : prendre la responsabilité d'environ 90 établissements de santé, dont un tiers de grands comptes, définir une segmentation pertinente et prioriser tes actions selon les enjeux et le potentiel de chaque client.

  • Développer des relations sur le long terme : comprendre les organisations de tes clients, naviguer entre différents niveaux d'interlocuteurs (décideurs, référents, utilisateurs) et construire des plans d'accompagnement adaptés à leurs objectifs.

  • Apporter un conseil approfondi sur nos solutions : analyser les besoins, maîtriser les configurations et les usages de nos produits, diagnostiquer les problématiques complexes et recommander les solutions les plus adaptées aux contraintes de chaque établissement.

  • Piloter des plans d'action orientés impact : t'appuyer sur les données d'usage et les indicateurs de performance pour identifier les opportunités, définir des actions prioritaires et mesurer leurs résultats dans la durée.

  • Faire évoluer nos pratiques Customer Success : collaborer avec les équipes Produit, Ops, Support et Sales et contribuer à l'amélioration de nos processus d'accompagnement, de segmentation et de suivi client.

⭐️ Le profil que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons un profil senior, capable de prendre de la hauteur, de piloter son portefeuille en autonomie et d'apporter une réelle valeur ajoutée stratégique à ses clients.

Tes expériences et compétences

  • Une expérience solide (idéalement 6 ans ou plus) en Customer Success, gestion de comptes stratégiques, conseil ou gestion de projets complexes, avec un haut niveau d'autonomie et de responsabilité.

  • Une expérience confirmée en gestion de portefeuille B2B, idéalement auprès de grands comptes multi-interlocuteurs, avec une vraie maîtrise de la segmentation, de la priorisation et des plans d'accompagnement orientés résultats.

  • Une forte expertise produit et une posture de conseil, acquises sur des solutions complexes nécessitant des configurations avancées, une analyse approfondie des besoins et des recommandations sur mesure.

  • Une approche analytique et structurée, avec une capacité à exploiter la donnée pour orienter tes décisions, mesurer ton impact et améliorer les processus d'accompagnement.

Une expérience dans le SaaS B2B, les solutions techniques ou le secteur de la santé est un plus, mais nous privilégions avant tout ton expérience et ta capacité à gérer des clients complexes.

Les qualités qui feront la différence

  • Hauteur de vue et leadership : tu sais prendre du recul, challenger tes interlocuteurs et construire une vision stratégique à long terme.

  • Rigueur et proactivité : tu es autonome, organisé(e), orienté(e) résultats et sais faire avancer plusieurs sujets complexes en parallèle.

  • Curiosité et excellent relationnel : tu aimes comprendre les produits en profondeur, poser les bonnes questions et communiquer avec clarté auprès d'interlocuteurs variés.

Nos valeurs

  • Embrace Complexity : tu aimes comprendre les sujets en profondeur, explorer des problématiques complexes et construire des solutions pertinentes plutôt que de t'arrêter à la première réponse.

  • Bienveillance : tu sais créer des relations de confiance, collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés et challenger de manière constructive.

  • Real Impact : tu recherches des résultats concrets et mesurables, aussi bien pour tes clients que pour l'amélioration de nos pratiques internes.

👥 Process de recrutement

  1. Échange avec Laura, Talent Acquisition – 30 min. Un premier échange pour comprendre ton parcours, tes attentes et ta motivation pour le poste.

  2. Entretien avec Pierre, Hiring Manager – 60 min. Une rencontre pour approfondir ton expérience de gestion de portefeuille, ton approche stratégique de la relation client, ton expertise produit et ta capacité à piloter des plans d'action orientés résultats.

  3. Étude de cas avec Pierre et un membre de l'équipe CS – 60 min. Tu recevras le cas quelques jours avant la restitution. L'objectif est d'évaluer ta capacité d'analyse, ton raisonnement, ta prise de recul et ta manière de structurer une stratégie d'accompagnement client.

  4. Entretien Cultural Alignment avec Raphaël, VP Ops – 30 min. Un échange pour discuter de ta manière de travailler, de tes valeurs et de ta collaboration avec les autres équipes.

Nous nous engageons à te faire un retour dans les 72 heures suivant chaque étape.

Informations pratiques : poste en CDI, basé idéalement à Paris mais ouvert à la France entière avec une présence régulière à Paris. Des déplacements dans les établissements de santé sont à prévoir, en moyenne deux par mois, avec une fréquence variable selon les besoins des clients.

jobs.title: Senior business analyst - deadline 03/11/2026
jobs.description:
Senior business analyst - deadline 03/11/2026

Job description :

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

  • Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

  • Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

  • User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

  • Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows.

  • Agile & SAFe Delivery: Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily meetings, system demos, and other Agile/SAFe ceremonies.

  • PI Preparation: Support pre-PI planning activities, identify knowledge gaps and dependencies, prepare refinement materials, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure feature readiness.

  • Definition of Ready & Definition of Done: Ensure that User Stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) before entering a sprint and contain the necessary information to support the Definition of Done (DoD).

  • Technical & Cross-Team Coordination: Collaborate with development leads, testers, Product Owners, and other teams to clarify technical feasibility, resolve dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope and responsibilities.

  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Prepare UAT scenarios, use cases, and sample test data; coordinate end-user testing; collect and analyze feedback; and document decisions and follow-up backlog items.

  • Delivery & Release Support: Verify that delivered functionality meets business requirements, prepare sprint release notes, and ensure that documentation, user guidance, and training materials are updated.

  • Documentation & Traceability: Maintain centralized and accessible project documentation in tools such as SharePoint or Wiki, ensuring traceability from Epics and Features through User Stories, acceptance tests, and releases.

  • AI-Assisted Analysis: Use AI capabilities such as Copilot, AI agents, and other relevant tools to support requirements gathering, process analysis, validation of assumptions, and initial solution ideation.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, improve requirements quality, and maintain a backlog buffer of approximately 1.5–2 sprints of ready User Stories.


Job requirments:

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.

  • Strong experience in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and documentation.

  • Practical knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including:

    • Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven apps)

    • Power BI

    • Power Pages

    • Microsoft Dataverse

    • Data models, access structures, and data integrations.

  • Experience defining and refining Epics, Features, User Stories, and detailed Acceptance Criteria.

  • Knowledge of backlog management, refinement sessions, sprint planning, and PI Planning.

  • Experience with business process modelling, process flows, mockups, business rules, data mappings, and impact assessments.

  • Understanding of functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, availability, security, auditability, and GDPR/privacy.

  • Knowledge of Definition of Ready (DoR), Definition of Done (DoD), and requirements traceability.

  • Experience supporting UAT, including test scenario preparation, test data coordination, feedback analysis, and defect or backlog item management.

  • Ability to identify dependencies, clarify scope, assess gaps, and coordinate with technical teams and business stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with technical documentation, solution architecture, data models, APIs, and integration flows.

  • Experience using documentation and collaboration tools such as SharePoint, Wiki, and backlog management platforms.

  • Awareness of AI tools, including Copilot and AI agents, for requirements analysis, process improvement, and solution ideation.

  • Strong communication, analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple features and priorities in a structured delivery environment.

Senior Application Engineer

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.


As a Senior Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of developing financial products that will shape the future of how businesses manage their finances. Along with expanding into new markets and handling an increasing volume of transactions, Mollie has recently introduced exciting new products to broaden our offering. You’ll have the opportunity to bring your ideas to life and contribute to these impactful projects. Mollie Capital offers easy access to flexible financing, providing funding to support growth and cash flow management. In-person payments, allows merchants to accept payments at their physical stores through our terminal and mobile app. These innovations are just the beginning, enabling Mollie to offer a seamless, all-in-one payment solution and money management platform.

Bouw jij mee aan betrouwbaar functioneel beheer voor applicaties die onze collega’s dagelijks nodig hebben? 

Wie ben jij

Als je aan de slag gaat bij het bedrijfsonderdeel IT, dan ga je de uitdaging aan om Univé fit en wendbaar te houden - in alle IT-opzichten. Je zal terechtkomen op de afdeling IT Kern binnen het team Backend Platform en je richten op de verzekerings- en/of HR-processen.

In algemene zin vinden we het belangrijk dat je:

Voorkomen, beperken en verzekeren heeft een centrale plek in de strategie van Univé. Wij helpen onze klanten risico’s te voorkomen en schade te beperken. En wat we niet kunnen voorkomen of beperken, verzekeren we gewoon goed.

De afdeling IT Kern, waaronder Backend Platform valt, levert een state-of-the-art IT-fundament voor de Univé-organisatie om de business doelen te realiseren. Dat doen we door waarde te creëren op continuïteit, betrouwbaarheid, schaalbaarheid, veiligheid en enabler te zijn van innovatie & productiviteit.

Voor Backend Platform zoeken wij een Business Informatie Analist. Als Business Informatie Analist werk je in op DevOps gebaseerde Agile teams en ben je continue bezig om de beloftes aan onze klanten waar te maken.

Je werk bestaat onder andere uit:

  • Analyseren van wensen en wijzigingen: Je onderzoekt wijzigingsverzoeken, brengt requirements in kaart en vertaalt deze naar passende functionele oplossingen.

  • Verbeteren van processen en systemen: Je signaleert knelpunten, onderzoekt verbetermogelijkheden en draagt bij aan het optimaliseren van bestaande processen en applicaties.

  • Ondersteunen van de applicatieketen: Je ondersteunt en verbetert de werking van applicaties en bijbehorende processen, waaronder verzekerings- en HR-processen en de systemen en koppelingen binnen de ATS-keten.

  • Bewaken van de ketensamenhang: Je overziet de impact van wijzigingen op applicaties, systemen en onderlinge koppelingen en draagt bij aan een stabiele en betrouwbare dienstverlening.

  • Continu verbeteren: Je denkt actief mee over het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening, werkwijzen en samenwerking binnen de Agile teams.

Wat bieden wij

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie, waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan professioneel en toekomstgericht Backend Platform.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, eigenaarschap en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling.

  • Nauwe samenwerking met ervaren collega’s binnen IT, architectuur en security.

  • Ruimte om mee te denken over marktontwikkelingen, automatisering en de inzet van AI binnen Unive en IT.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die dicht bij haar leden staat. Als IT-organisatie werken we aan een wendbaar, betrouwbaar, veilig en toekomstgericht IT-landschap. Schaalbare technologie, goede processen, standaardisatie en continu verbeteren zijn daarbij belangrijk. Binnen IT Kern werken verschillende teams aan het beheren, ondersteunen en doorontwikkelen van applicaties, platformen, infrastructuur, netwerkdiensten en securityoplossingen. Deze IT-diensten zijn essentieel voor onze dagelijkse dienstverlening aan leden en voor de ondersteuning van onze collega’s. Samen bouwen we aan een moderne IT-organisatie waarin we betrouwbaar functioneren, waardestromen goed worden ondersteund en vernieuwing gecontroleerd en toekomstbestendig kan plaatsvinden. Je komt terecht in een team waarin samenwerking, eigenaarschap en plezier in het werk belangrijk zijn. We werken met collega’s die graag verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en elkaar helpen om het applicatie- en IT-landschap iedere dag een stukje beter te maken.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Platform
jobs.description:
Director of Product Management, Platform

Who We Are

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform coupled with an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 500 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce at our company. At Cobalt we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations in order to continue to nurture our unique rich diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

Description

Cobalt is hiring a Director of Product Management, Platform to own the product surfaces that connect our pentesting offerings to the rest of a customer's security and business stack, and that make those offerings easy to evaluate, configure, and scale. This is a newly created role on the Product leadership team, reporting to the VP of Product Management, with direct accountability for platform architecture decisions, the partner and integration ecosystem, pricing and packaging mechanics, access and permissions models, and the operational backbone (tooling, metrics, content) that the rest of Product relies on.

You will lead a team spanning Customer Experience, Product Operations, and Platform/Integrations PMs, and you will be the primary product partner to Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Security/Compliance stakeholders on anything that touches how customers connect to, configure, and pay for Cobalt. This is a high-visibility, build-and-scale role: you'll inherit a working integrations program (including a recently shipped Wiz integration) and a clear mandate to mature it into a defensible platform and ecosystem strategy.

What You'll Own

  • Platform & Integrations Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for Cobalt's integration ecosystem (e.g., SFDC, Slack/MS Teams, ticketing and automation tools), including build-vs-partner decisions and a prioritization framework tied to revenue and retention impact.
  • Ecosystem & Partnerships: Own the product side of technology partnerships — API/webhook strategy, partner onboarding requirements, and joint roadmap alignment with strategic integration partners.
  • Pricing & Packaging: Partner with Finance, Sales, and the VP of Product to design and evolve pricing and packaging across the tiered portfolio, including credits, contracts, and tier-based feature and integration entitlements.
  • Roles, Permissions & Access (RBAC): Own the roadmap for role-based access control, authentication, and customer administration capabilities that meet enterprise security and compliance expectations.
  • Customer Experience Alignment: Absorb and elevate the Customer Focus charter — customer journey, scoping and calculator experience, findings/reports, asset and engagement management, and customer-facing catalogue — ensuring platform decisions are grounded in real customer workflows.
  • Product Operations Leadership: Oversee the operating rhythm of the Product org — roadmap cadence, QBRs, Product Hour, in-platform content (Pendo), technical publications, usage/experience metrics, and tooling/vendor contract management.
  • Team Leadership: Manage and develop a team of PMs and product operations professionals; set goals, coach for growth, and represent the team's roadmap to the VP of Product and cross-functional leadership.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Partner closely with Engineering leads and Design to translate platform strategy into epics, acceptance criteria, and shippable releases, and with Customer Success/Sales to ensure GTM readiness for platform and integration launches.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

  • A published platform and integration roadmap, prioritized against a clear framework, with at least one new strategic integration shipped.
  • A documented pricing/packaging model for tier-based feature and integration entitlements, adopted by Sales and Finance.
  • An RBAC and permissions framework that closes known enterprise/compliance gaps and is referenceable in security reviews.
  • A unified Product Operations cadence (roadmaps, QBR, Product Hour, usage metrics) running reliably across the org.
  • A team of PMs operating with clear ownership, a healthy backlog discipline, and strong cross-functional trust with Engineering, Design, and GTM.

You Must Have

  • 8+ years in product management, including 3+ years in a people-leadership role (Director, Group PM, or equivalent), ideally within B2B SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • Demonstrated experience owning platform, integrations, or ecosystem products — defining build-vs-partner tradeoffs and shipping API/webhook-based integrations at scale.
  • Direct experience with pricing and packaging design for a multi-tier or multi-product SaaS portfolio.
  • Working knowledge of access control, authentication, and enterprise security/compliance requirements (RBAC, SSO, SAML/OIDC) as they apply to product design.
  • A track record of leading product operations or platform functions that support an entire product organization (metrics, tooling, roadmap cadence), not just a single product line.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills — proven ability to align Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success around a shared roadmap.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting strategy and tradeoffs to executive leadership.
  • Bonus: experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, or pentesting/offensive security domains; familiarity with Salesforce, Jira/Confluence, and Pendo.

Why You Should Join Us

  • Grow in a passionate, rapidly expanding industry operating at the forefront of the Pentesting industry
  • Work directly with experienced senior leaders with ongoing mentorship opportunities
  • Earn competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan
  • Save for the future with a 401(k) program (US) or pension (EU)
  • Benefit from medical, dental, vision and life insurance (US) or statutory healthcare (EU)
  • Leverage stipends for:
    • Wellness
    • Work-from-home equipment & wifi
