jobs.description:
Staff Security Analyst - GRC

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

A Staff Security Analyst will be a critical member of the GRC team working within the Information Security organization and across the business to advise, build, and operate security and compliance programs at scale. Utilizing in-depth expertise across multiple disciplines, you will be responsible for executing various components of Harness' security posture and overseeing end-to-end solutions to complex compliance problems.

As a Staff Security Analyst, you will lead security efforts to acquire and maintain crucial compliance certifications across Commercial sectors while assisting with Federal initiatives. You will design solutions that enable Harness' security goals and collaborate directly with business and engineering teams to preserve velocity while ensuring top-tier security. This role requires a strong core in Commercial Compliance mastery (SOC 2, SOC 1, ISO 27k, HIPAA, PCI), Customer Trust experience, and hands-on GRC Engineering and Automation capabilities, complemented by familiarity with Federal Compliance (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53).

About the role

  • Commercial Compliance Management: Design, implement, and continuously monitor commercial compliance controls, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure environments are properly scoped and secured for SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and HIPAA.
  • GRC Engineering & Automation: Develop and implement automation solutions to scale compliance tasks, automate control testing, integrate continuous compliance checks into the CI/CD pipeline, and streamline reporting.
  • Federal Compliance Support: Contribute to Federal compliance initiatives and frameworks (such as FedRAMP Moderate+, CMMC, DoD IL, and FedRAMP 20x) as Harness expands its public sector footprint.
  • Customer Trust & Advisory: Support customer trust initiatives by reviewing contracts for security and privacy requirements, completing detailed customer security questionnaires, and maintaining the customer trust portal.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Contribute precise and actionable guidance to ensure security and privacy by design for engineering, product, and business initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Manage relationships and facilitate engagement with external suppliers, auditors, assessors, and enterprise prospects.
  • Risk Management: Identify, track, and mitigate risks related to compliance projects, continuously monitor supply chain security, and manage vendor risk.
  • Evangelism: Articulate Harness's security capabilities and controls clearly to enterprise customers and regulatory auditors

About you

  • You have a minimum of 8-10 years of relevant industry experience in security, compliance, and GRC program management.
  • Extensive exposure to commercial industry regulations, frameworks, and compliance certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA).
  • Previous experience with GRC tools and a demonstrated ability to build automation for security and compliance controls in a cloud-native environment (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Working knowledge or exposure to Federal compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST 800-53, FedRAMP, CMMC) and are interested in expanding these programs.
  • You possess strong cybersecurity acumen and solid technical proficiency with enterprise SaaS applications and infrastructure.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to handle multiple priorities and build new programs from scratch.
  • Clear, concise communication skills, both written and verbal, and can effectively partner with technical engineering teams as well as non-technical stakeholders.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity in complex, fast-paced situations.

Bonus Points!

  • You have hands-on experience building, delivering, or managing a FedRAMP-compliant service offering (FedRAMP Moderate+) or achieving an ATO.
  • Familiarity with specialized defense/federal environments like Platform One, Iron Bank, CMMC, or DoD IL.
  • You are familiar with what is going on under the hood of the AWS or GCP console and can speak to best practices for configuration and management.
  • You hold relevant security or technical certifications (ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, PCI QSA, CISA, CISSP, PMP, AWS/GCP Professional, or FedRAMP-specific credentials).
  • Previous experience assessing and utilizing AI in a secure environment.
  • You have exposure to or experience with Kubernetes, SBOMs, SLSA, and/or DLP.
  • You like to "automate the boring stuff" and are eager to share your knowledge with junior colleagues

Work Location

  • Remote within the U.S or Hybrid from one of our offices.

What you will have at Harness

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
  • Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events
  • Monthly internet reimbursement

The anticipated base salary range for this position is between $150,000 and $164,000 annually. Salary is determined by a combination of factors including location, level, relevant experience, and skills. Wir sind Finanzcheck – der Online-Kreditvergleich und Go-To-Place für Kredite in Deutschland. Wir gestalten den digitalen Kreditmarkt der Zukunft und wurden 2022 als Kununu Top Arbeitgeber ausgezeichnet. Werde jetzt Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte!

Zur Verstärkung unseres Vertriebsteams mit knapp 100 Finanzprofis suchen wir dich ab sofort in Vollzeit als:

Bankkaufmann/-frau - als Kreditspezialist im Homeoffice (w/m/d)

So sieht dein Team aus:

Gemeinsam mit deinen zukünftigen Kolleg*innen berätst du unsere Kund*innen rund um das Thema Konsumentenkredite und erfüllst tagtäglich ihre größten Wünsche. Bei uns erwartet dich eine offene Kultur mit flachen Hierarchien, starken Teams und genügend Raum, um dich selbst mit einbringen zu können. Wir von FINANZCHECK.de sorgen dafür, dass all unsere Mitarbeiter*innen den für sich richtigen Platz finden, denn bei uns steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt.

Deine Rolle bei uns

  • Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kund*innen und berätst diese telefonisch und schriftlich beim Kreditvergleich
  • Du begleitest deine Kund*innen vom Erstkontakt bis hin zum Vertragsabschluss und unterstützt sie dabei in allen Phasen
  • Mit einer gründlichen Bedarfsanalyse findest du heraus, was unsere Kund*innen wirklich benötigen und hilfst ihnen, das optimale Kreditangebot zu finden
  • Du unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, ihre Wünsche zu erfüllen, und das ganz ohne Kaltakquise, da alle unsere Kunden aktiv ihre Daten bei uns hinterlassen haben
  • Dank unserer modernen Kommunikationstools und den digitalen Abschlussmöglichkeiten unserer Partner steht einem effizienten Arbeitsalltag nichts im Wege

Das bringst du mit

  • Du konntest bereits erste Erfahrung im Kund*innenkontakt sammeln (z.B. Vertrieb, Sales, Telesales oder Verkauf)
  • Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und überzeugst durch deine offene und professionelle Art am Telefon
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine hohe Zuverlässigkeit und eine engagierte Arbeitsweise aus
  • Du hast Lust dich weiterzuentwickeln, bringst viel Motivation mit und möchtest gemeinsam mit uns durchstarten
  • Deutsch beherrschst du fließend in Wort und Schrift
  • Du verfügst idealerweise über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung

Dein Einstieg im Vertrieb bei Finanzcheck

Du hast Lust, mit uns durchzustarten und dich beruflich weiterzuentwickeln?

  • Wir fördern dein Potenzial und unterstützen dich bei der Entwicklung zum Vertriebsprofi bei Finanzcheck
  • Durch unsere umfassende Einarbeitung erwirbst du alle nötigen Kenntnisse im Bereich Kreditberatung & Vertrieb

Unser erfahrenes Team unterstützt dich von Beginn an durch umfangreiches Coaching und hilft dir dabei dich im Vertrieb selbst zu verwirklichen

  • Deine Motivation wird bei uns belohnt: Profitiere von unserem Gehaltsmodell mit ungedeckelter Provision!
  • Interne Karriereprogramme, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Coaching Angebote unterstützen dich bei deiner beruflichen Entwicklung
  • Work-Life-Balance: Genieße die Flexibilität, zu 100% deutschlandweit im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.
    • Du wohnst in Berlin oder Hamburg? Auch für dich haben wir drei Tage Homeoffice: Mit einem Hybridmodell schaffen wir die perfekte Balance zwischen Fokuszeit und Team-Spirit in unseren modernen Büros vor Ort.
  • Deine Einarbeitung erfolgt vollständig digital, und wir kümmern uns um die unkomplizierte Zusendung des benötigten Equipments vor Jobbeginn.
  • Für deine Erholung gibt es 30 Tage Urlaub, Eltern profitieren von 10-Kind Krank Tagen zusätzlich zum gesetzlichen Anspruch

Benefits

jobs.title: Product Owner - Acquitech
jobs.description:
Product Owner - Acquitech

Product Owner - Sales & Marketing, Acquisition Technology

Hybrid in London, UK

We're looking for a Product Owner to join the Acquitech team.

You'll own the roadmap for the team behind iwoca's acquisition data, technology and models.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star service ensure business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they power.

The team

Acquitech builds and maintains the data infrastructure behind iwoca's direct acquisition channels. The team's aim is to get the right data to the right places – so ad platforms find businesses worth reaching, analysts trust the reports they build, and the sales team knows who to call first.

The team works across four areas:

  • Tracking and attribution. Recording every lead and sign-up accurately, and sending conversion data back to ad platforms so their algorithms improve over time.

  • Customer value prediction. Building models that estimate a potential customer's expected value, used to guide where marketing spends, who receives direct mail and which businesses a salesperson prioritises.

  • The data layer. Providing a clear, trusted foundation so analysts and channel managers can build reporting without second-guessing the numbers.

  • Team tooling and automation. Building tools and automated workflows, from automating sales task assignment to running LLM analysis on sales calls so the team can review performance at scale.

The team is small – three engineers, two data scientists and you – with the senior engineer sharing the day-to-day leadership. You'll report to a Senior Product Owner in an adjacent team.

The role

As Product Owner in Acquitech, you'll turn requests from marketing and sales into well-scoped work the team can deliver, and own the roadmap. You'll have real ownership of systems that directly shape acquisition spend, and the space to move quickly in a small, capable team. The work mixes delivery – compliance sign-offs, ad platform integrations and product changes – with discovery cycles where you prototype and test ideas quickly.

You'll become the go-to person for Acquitech systems and processes, and you'll use AI to multiply what a small team can deliver – from prototyping ideas to automating workflows for the team and its stakeholders.

  • Roadmap and priorities. You'll own priorities across Acquitech's work, writing clear requirements and seeing them through to release. You'll set direction with the Head of Direct Acquisition and the channel leads who depend on the team.

  • Tracking and ad platform integrations. You'll lead the team's work on conversion tracking, custom audiences and API migrations. You'll own the product change documentation that comes with them, working through Compliance, Data Privacy and Legal.

  • Discovery. You'll run discovery work to find new opportunities, using AI to prototype and test ideas quickly, and bring findings back to the wider business – for example through weekly learning sessions.

  • Ways of working. You'll run the team's rhythms – stand-ups, retros and monthly reviews – and set clear quarterly goals.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Product ownership. You've worked in a product role, managing several projects end to end – writing requirements, owning priorities and being accountable for results.

  • Data literacy. You use data to diagnose problems, size opportunities and evaluate whether a release delivered what you hoped.

  • Technical fluency. You can discuss trade-offs with engineers around APIs, tracking pipelines and data flows. You follow the argument without needing everything translated.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly. You adapt technical detail for commercial colleagues and commercial context for engineers.

  • Leadership. You're comfortable running stand-ups and retros, setting quarterly goals and keeping priorities clear.

  • AI leverage. You've built AI workflows, or used AI to produce specs, analysis, or prototypes beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

Bonus:

  • Marketing technology. You've worked with tools such as Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, Google Ads or Meta Ads, or on conversion tracking and attribution.

  • Analytics tools. You've used Looker, Amplitude or a similar analytics platform to build or maintain reporting.

  • Data pipelines. You understand ETL concepts or database architecture.

  • Data science collaboration. You've worked alongside data scientists or contributed to a modelling project.

  • Regulated products. You've worked in fintech, lending or another regulated product area.

The salary

We expect to pay from £50,000 to £70,000 for this role. We're open-minded, so include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every team member always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • 25 days' holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

jobs.description:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer | SRE (Remote, EU/CET)

About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal.

Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales.

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build secure, reliable, and scalable systems as Maze grows.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, reliability, and security. You’ll work across our platform to improve how we operate production systems, strengthen our security practices, and give engineers the tooling and infrastructure they need to ship quickly and confidently.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working across boundaries, takes ownership, and brings a pragmatic approach to solving problems. You don’t need to be an expert in every part of our stack, but you should be excited to learn, move quickly, and make an impact.

As an SRE at Maze, you will:

  • Build, operate, and evolve our cloud infrastructure with reliability, scalability, and security in mind

  • Improve our observability practices and help engineers understand, debug, and operate systems in production

  • Partner across engineering and security to strengthen our cloud security posture and operational practices

  • Support security and compliance initiatives, including vulnerability management, security testing, and audit readiness

  • Build tooling and automation that reduces manual work and improves the developer experience

  • Bring an operational and security perspective to architecture and technical decisions

  • Improve how we prepare for, respond to, and learn from production incidents

  • Use modern AI-assisted and agentic workflows to build, debug, and operate systems more effectively

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has experience building and operating production systems in a modern cloud environment, ideally AWS

  • Understands modern SRE and infrastructure practices, including infrastructure as code and containerized workloads

  • Has experience with observability and knows what good monitoring, alerting, and production visibility look like

  • Brings a security mindset, with experience or interest in cloud security, vulnerability management, application security, or related areas

  • Has exposure to security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001, or is interested in developing deeper expertise in this area

  • Can automate repetitive work using code and is comfortable working with at least one programming language

  • Is excited about AI-assisted development and actively uses modern AI tools in their work

  • Thrives in a fast-moving environment where ownership, curiosity, and pragmatic decision-making matter

The stack

  • Cloud & infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Security & compliance: Vanta, Socket

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Argo CD

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Snowflake

  • Application: TypeScript, Node.js, React

You don’t need experience with every technology in our stack. We care more about strong fundamentals, an ability to learn quickly, and excitement about helping us build reliable and secure systems as Maze scales.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture. 

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

  • Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

  • Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

  • Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

Benefits

  • Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid

    • For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information

  • Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources

  • Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid

  • Flexible time off

  • Meaningful equity

  • Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze

  • New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze

  • Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents

  • $500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage

    • If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever!

  • $1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space

  • Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours

  • Monthly Bonus.ly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more

  • Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year

  • SWAG, we have some really cool swag

  • Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more

Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here. 

Outreach Notice

We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application, as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
jobs.description:
Chief Engineer Operations H/F

📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite

Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques.

Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer.

Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse, vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites.

Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique.

Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance.

Vos missions

Votre rôle

Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite.

Vous êtes à la fois :

  • un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ;

  • un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ;

  • un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents.

Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre.

Vos principales missions

1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques

Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels.

Votre périmètre couvre notamment :

  • les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ;

  • les systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • les UPS / onduleurs ;

  • les groupes électrogènes ;

  • les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ;

  • les systèmes de refroidissement ;

  • la protection et la sécurité incendie ;

  • les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées.

Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations, et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques.

2 - Sécuriser les opérations

L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques.

À ce titre, vous :

  • challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ;

  • identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ;

  • sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ;

  • challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ;

  • pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ;

  • accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ;

  • contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification.

Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation, avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service.

3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques

L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites.

Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels.

Vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

  • structurer les processus d'exploitation ;

  • définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ;

  • rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ;

  • mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ;

  • contrôler leur bonne application ;

  • identifier les écarts entre les sites ;

  • proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ;

  • partager les bonnes pratiques ;

  • réaliser des REX multisites ;

  • accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards.

La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique.

4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques

En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations.

Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à :

  • analyser techniquement l'incident ;

  • identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ;

  • apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ;

  • challenger les analyses proposées ;

  • accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ;

  • contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ;

  • participer à la résolution de l'incident ;

  • organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites.

Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle.

5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle

Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation.

Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à :

  • former et accompagner les équipes ;

  • expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ;

  • faire progresser les pratiques ;

  • fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ;

  • accompagner la conduite du changement ;

  • favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites.

Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct.

6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs

Vous serez capable de :

  • représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ;

  • expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ;

  • présenter les actions mises en œuvre ;

  • répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ;

  • apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures.

Une organisation en construction

Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré, regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets.

L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec :

  • les responsables de site ;

  • les équipes Facility et Operations ;

  • les équipes projets ;

  • les experts techniques ;

  • les prestataires et partenaires externes ;

  • les fonctions transverses ;

  • les clients majeurs.

Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes.

Vos compétences

Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement Data Center ou infrastructure critique fortement structurée.

Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées.

Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée.

Votre expertise technique

Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment :

  • électricité HT/BT ;

  • systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • UPS / groupes électrogènes ;

  • CVC / HVAC ;

  • refroidissement ;

  • protection incendie ;

  • contrôle-commande ;

  • maintenance des infrastructures critiques.

Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes, et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial.

Vous savez également analyser une problématique technique complexe, identifier les risques et challenger les solutions proposées.

Votre expérience opérationnelle

Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement où les procédures et les standards opérationnels occupent une place importante.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec :

  • les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • la gestion des changements ;

  • l'analyse de risques ;

  • la maintenance préventive et corrective ;

  • la gestion d'incidents critiques ;

  • les audits et contrôles opérationnels ;

  • les REX ;

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer (F/H/NB)
jobs.description:
AI Software Engineer (F/H/NB)

SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA.

  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique.

  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network.

  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...

  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute.

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

▪️ À propos du poste

Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise.

Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous.

Les missions :

  • Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine).

  • Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS).

  • Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée.

  • Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu.

  • Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle.

  • Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord.

  • Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act).

  • S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts.

  • Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR.

▪️ Le profil idéal

  • 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA
  • Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...)
  • Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A)
  • Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte
  • Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles
  • Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu
  • Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA

Un plus

  • Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…)
  • Connaissance de la méthodologie BMAD 
  • Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Gemini),
  • Sensibilité sécurité : modèles de menaces sur les agents, gestion des identités et des permissions
  • Notions de RAG, vues comme un outil de l’agent
  • Contributions open source, side projects agentiques, talks

▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais 

L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo et GenAI) avec deux Sfeirians.
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

Prêt·e à passer au niveau supérieur sans renoncer à tes valeurs ? Postule et viens rencontrer le collectif !

jobs.title: Head of Consulting (Sales & New Business) (80–100 %)

Schweizer Engineering für die Software von morgen.

novu baut keine Lösungen von der Stange, sondern Individualsoftware, die zum Geschäft unserer Kunden passt. Wir definieren, entwickeln, betreiben und erweitern sie, alles im Haus und alles in der Schweiz, mit rund 50 Leuten in Zürich und Bern. novu gehört zur Union Group AG, einer Gruppe von Schweizer Agenturen für digitale Kommunikation.

Software entsteht mit AI immer schneller. Umso mehr zählt, wer versteht, was Kunden wirklich brauchen, und wer ihr Vertrauen über Jahre gewinnt. Genau dafür bist du da: Als Head of Consulting verantwortest du das Neugeschäft von novu, führst unser Consulting-Team und prägst, wie wir beraten. Du berichtest an den CEO und arbeitest im Führungsteam eng mit CTO und Head of Operations zusammen. Arbeiten kannst du wahlweise von Zürich oder Bern aus.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du verantwortest das Neugeschäft: Du baust eine belastbare Pipeline auf, gehst aktiv auf potenzielle Kunden zu, führst Pitches und schliesst Aufträge ab. Du kennst deine Zahlen und steuerst danach.

  • Du führst das Consulting-Team: Du rekrutierst, gibst klares Feedback, führst die Standortgespräche und entwickelst die Beratungskompetenz jeder Person gezielt weiter.

  • Du prägst, wie novu berät: Du setzt Standards für Angebote, Kundenführung und eine schlanke Projektführung und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden.

  • Mit CTO und Head of Operations stimmst du Prioritäten und Kapazitäten ab, damit wir halten, was wir verkaufen.

  • Gemeinsam mit dem CEO entwickelst du Angebot und Preismodelle weiter, gerade dort, wo AI verändert, wie Software entsteht und was Kunden dafür bezahlen. Den Einsatz von AI im Consulting treibst du selbst voran.

Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung und Business Development rund um Software, Digitalprojekte oder IT-Dienstleistungen, idealerweise in einer Agentur. Du hast nachweislich Neugeschäft gewonnen und grössere Mandate selbst abgeschlossen.

  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast ein Team geführt, idealerweise Consultants oder Projektleiterinnen und Projektleiter, und Menschen spürbar weiterentwickelt.

  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Geschäftsleitungen. Ein Netzwerk in der Schweizer Wirtschaft, auf das du aufbauen kannst, ist ein grosses Plus.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du argumentierst mit Zahlen, kalkulierst sauber und verhandelst souverän.

  • Du begeisterst dich für AI, probierst neue Werkzeuge selbst aus und kannst einschätzen, wie sie Beratung und Softwareentwicklung verändern.

  • Ein professionelles, verbindliches Auftreten, stilsicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Du hast deinen Wohnsitz in der Schweiz oder bist bereit, hierher zu ziehen.

Was wir bieten

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle im Führungsteam von novu mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Ein Engineering-Team von rund 30 Leuten, das umsetzt, was du verkaufst.

  • Den Rückhalt einer Gruppe von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden in vier Agenturen, mit der du Kunden ganzheitlich beraten kannst.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Leader, Consumer Business Services
jobs.description:
Enterprise Sales Leader, Consumer Business Services

About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

About the Consumer Business Services team

  • Sierra partners with the businesses that power everyday life for consumers and enterprises alike — from the CPG brands on every shelf to the logistics networks that get products there, the real estate and facilities teams that manage the buildings people live and work in, and the energy and utility providers that keep the lights on. Our agents handle everything from order tracking and account management to field service scheduling and billing support, tuned to the voice and workflows of each business.

  • This vertical spans a wide range of industries — consumer products, commercial real estate, automotive & mobility, transportation & logistics, industrial manufacturing, information & data services, consumer electronics, professional services, facilities management, construction, energy, and utilities — giving you the breadth to build relationships across some of the largest and most established companies in the world.

  • Join us to bring AI agents to the businesses that quietly run the economy — and help build technology that makes these essential services faster, more reliable, and more human for everyone who depends on them.

What you'll do

  • Lead & develop a high-performing sales team: Hire, onboard, and develop AEs across your region, Coach reps on deal strategy, pipeline management, and execution. Create a culture of accountability, learning, and collaboration. Identify and grow future leaders on your team.

  • Own regional performance: Own your regional number and forecast accuracy, Inspect pipeline quality and help unblock stalled deals. Drive consistent execution of our sales process. Partner with RevOps to ensure clean data and clear insights.

  • Be deeply involved in deals: Join key customer and prospect conversations. Help reps navigate complex buying committees and late-stage deals. Support pricing, negotiation, and close strategy.

What you'll bring

  • 10-15+ years of experience: Extensive experience in enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

  • People leadership experience: 5+ years managing, mentoring, and developing a high-performing enterprise sales team.

  • Enterprise experience: You've run and managed end-to-end complex deals ($1M+).

  • Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

  • Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

Even better...

  • Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends, as well as fluency with AI tooling and workflows.

  • Experience building GTM strategies: Building sales teams and sales motions from scratch, or from early stage growth.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. Staff Software Engineer I, Platform Engineering

At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy.

Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here!

Signifyd is looking to hire a Staff Software Engineer I for its Platform Engineering group. Within our broader Engineering organization, this pivotal role will set the technical vision and long-term strategy for our enterprise cloud infrastructure, driving its design and evolution across multiple engineering teams. You will provide technical leadership that extends beyond the Platform team, partnering with engineering leaders, peers, and cross-functional stakeholders to shape how Signifyd builds, automates, and scales the vast computing environment that supports our core decision platform for customers. This includes championing how AI and intelligent automation get built into the platform like self-healing infrastructure and AI-assisted incident response to the reliable, scalable systems that host Signifyd's own platform in production. Thriving in an innovative culture of rapid iteration and continuous learning, you will operate with significant autonomy in organization wide problem spaces, ensuring technical decisions align with while actively shaping strategic business outcomes. To ensure seamless system operations at scale, the ideal candidate will possess a strong software development skillset, exceptional analytical and communication skills, and deep technical proficiency across cloud technologies, containers, Kubernetes, cloud networking, security, and platform engineering. Fluency in applying AI and machine learning to platform problems such as intelligent automation, anomaly detection, and AI-assisted developer tooling. The knowledge of the infrastructure needed to run AI/ML workloads reliably at scale is a strong plus, along with a demonstrated track record of driving initiatives that span multiple teams.

About Signifyd

Signifyd protects ecommerce businesses from fraud and abuse with a 100% financial guarantee, using machine learning, big data, and human expertise to help merchants sell more, safely. We work with customers ranging from emerging startups to large-scale enterprises processing millions of transactions, and there's a lot more ground to cover — which means real ownership and real impact for the people building our platform.

About Platform Engineering

Platform Engineering builds and operates the foundational systems that power Signifyd globally — cloud infrastructure, containers and Kubernetes, cloud networking, and security — along with the self-healing automation that keeps our core decision platform running reliably at scale. The team is also responsible for building AI and intelligent automation directly into the platform, from AI-assisted incident response to the infrastructure that reliably runs Signifyd's own AI/ML workloads in production.

What You’ll Do

As a Staff Software Engineer in Platform Engineering capability, you will play a key leadership role in setting the technical vision and long-term strategy for Signifyd's enterprise cloud infrastructure. You will decide how Signifyd automates, scales, and secures the computing environment behind our core decision platform. You will partner with engineering leaders, Staff+ peers, and cross-functional stakeholders to turn ambiguous, org-wide problems into concrete technical direction, operating with significant autonomy well beyond the scope of any single team. You will also help bring AI and machine learning into how the platform runs itself — intelligent automation, anomaly detection, AI-assisted developer tooling, and the infrastructure needed to run AI/ML workloads reliably at scale.

Pioneer AI-Driven Infrastructure

  • Build the future: Define the architectural strategy for integrating LLM-powered, agentic tools across the platform. Set the technical direction for self-healing infrastructure and automated root-cause analysis, influencing multiple teams' roadmaps to cut operational toil and speed up incident resolution.

Architect for Scale, Security & Reliability

  • Evolve the ecosystem: Own the multi-quarter roadmap for our GCP and Kubernetes-based cloud capabilities, balancing developer feedback with emerging cloud technologies and building consensus among senior stakeholders.
  • Drive operational excellence: Set the standard for SLOs and incident management across the platform, and share ownership of platform health through on-call rotations — using those frontline insights to harden systems at scale.
  • Embed security: Architect access controls, encryption, and vulnerability management as a foundational platform standard that keeps the platform secure without slowing developer velocity.
  • Optimize footprint: Set the strategic direction for cloud capacity management and FinOps, delivering efficient scaling and cost transparency that other teams adopt as the standard.

Elevate Developer Experience (DevEx)

  • Productize the platform: Own the technical strategy for turning CI/CD (GitHub Actions, TeamCity), deployment (ArgoCD), and build tooling into a cohesive, self-service product — driving Change Failure Rate toward zero across engineering.
  • Pave the golden path: Define the platform standards built directly into our tooling, so the right way is automatically the fastest and easiest way for every engineer at Signifyd.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Solve systemic problems: Serve as the escalation point for the most complex, ambiguous infrastructure challenges, delivering durable fixes and shaping how other teams approach similar problems.
  • Champion the culture: Foster a customer-focused engineering culture, mentor engineers at every level, raise the technical bar, and advocate for product-thinking and empathy for the developer experience.

What You'll Bring

Cloud & Infrastructure Mastery

  • Cloud Platform: Deep, demonstrated mastery of Google Cloud Platform (GCP); AWS experience is a strong plus. Expert-level knowledge of cloud networking, protocols, and security best practices, with a track record of setting standards others follow.
  • Kubernetes: Extensive expertise in architecting and operating self-managed and cloud-managed Kubernetes environments at scale, including setting Kubernetes strategy across multiple teams.
  • Data Systems: Proven experience in architecting and scaling data storage and streaming technologies (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Kafka) in ways that shape platform-wide standards.

Software Engineering & DevEx

  • Coding Proficiency: Strong software development skills in high-level languages (e.g., Python, Go, Java, TypeScript), with a history of setting engineering practices adopted beyond your immediate team.
  • IaC & GitOps: Demonstrated ability to architect secure, self-service infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) and declarative CI/CD pipelines (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, TeamCity), driving down Change Failure Rate across teams.

Observability & AI Fluency

  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with modern AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude), paired with the critical judgment to audit AI-generated code for security, correctness, and long-term maintainability — and to set guidelines for how teams adopt these tools responsibly.
  • Telemetry: Experience architecting scalable, OpenTelemetry-based monitoring and tracing that helps engineering teams quickly pinpoint bottlenecks and lower MTTR.

Vision & Delivery

  • Architectural Mindset: Deep, cross-domain expertise in cloud security, cost optimization (FinOps), and performance efficiency, with a demonstrated ability to translate that expertise into technical strategy.
  • Execution: A track record of driving complex, cross-team technical initiatives to completion in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, with minimal oversight.

About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. Enterprise Account Manager, Creditors Rights & Collections

Location: Remote
Travel required: 20% for client visits and industry events

We're Proof, a high-growth startup in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We offer a best-in-class legal services platform used by thousands of law firms and property management companies. Our platform enables law firms and collections parties to access efficient, transparent, and accessible legal and document delivery services, traditionally out of reach. We are on a path to double our business this year and are building a team to help us scale rapidly.

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds who are eager to help build a future where legal services are readily accessible, affordable, and efficient. If you have curiosity, passion, and a collaborative spirit to drive change in an outdated industry, we want you on our team.

About the Role:

We are hiring an Account Manager to own the post-contract relationship for our Creditors' Rights accounts. You take the handoff from the sales team at contract signing and own everything from there: onboarding, ramp, retention, and growth. New logos are assigned to you throughout the year as they close.

The firms you will be managing file thousands of cases a month across multiple states, run formal audit programs, and hold their vendors to documented SLAs. You need to know their workflow, their plaintiff clients, and their operational requirements.

The right person is organized, proactive, and comfortable with operational complexity. You do not wait for clients to surface problems. You understand what good looks like for a creditors' rights firm and you hold Proof accountable to it.

What You'll Do:

Onboarding and Scoping

  • Take the handoff from the Account Executive at contract signing and lead the firm through onboarding.
  • Define state footprint, plaintiff client mix, reporting requirements, serve attempt rules, e-filing setup, and exception handling.
  • Set ramp milestones, volume targets, and reporting cadence with the firm in the first 30 days. Document and share these internally so every team member knows what was committed.
  • Ensure the platform is configured to match what was sold. What the contract says and what the system does need to be the same thing.
  • Identify and resolve onboarding blockers early, whether that is alt-service setup, e-filing registration, bulk upload format, or platform access, before they delay volume.
  • Partner with the Solutions Architect to ensure customer success.

Retention and Account Health

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for your accounts. You are the person a Managing Partner or Director of Operations reaches out to when something is wrong, and you own getting it resolved.
  • Maintain a regular communication cadence, monthly reviews for core accounts and formal QBRs for enterprise accounts.
  • Monitor account health: serve rate, filing SLA adherence, volume trends, open job aging, complaint rate. Surface negative trends before the client does.
  • Flag at-risk accounts early and escalate internally with enough specificity that the team can act on it.

Expansion and Growth

  • Find and develop expansion opportunities within your existing book. New states, new plaintiff clients, new service types.
  • You own the commercial conversation on expansion. You identify the opportunity, you propose and negotiate the expanded scope, and you onboard it.
  • Own renewal conversations. You know the account better than anyone and you are responsible for making the case for renewal and negotiating the terms.

Platform and Industry Fluency

    • Develop deep knowledge of the Proof platform. You need to know what it can do, what it cannot, how to configure it correctly, and where the edge cases are.
    • Understand the end-to-end service of process workflow: job creation, server assignment, attempt cadence, affidavit generation, e-filing, and billing.
    • Learn the state-specific service of process rules for your accounts' active jurisdictions. At minimum, you should know what constitutes valid service, what the filing SLA is, and what alt-service options exist.

What You'll Bring:

  • Required

    • 3 or more years of account management or client services experience in a B2B environment. Experience working with creditors’ rights law firms, law firms generally, or in the legal services space is strongly preferred.
    • Strong organizational discipline. You manage a multi-account book without dropping things, keep your notes and CRM current, and close every open item.
    • Clear, direct communication skills. You can write a straightforward status update to a Managing Partner and a clear internal escalation to an ops team in the same afternoon.
    • Proactive mindset. You surface problems before they become crises. You do not wait for a client to bring you something you should have caught.
    • Comfort with operational complexity. This is not a role where the product does everything cleanly. You will regularly manage billing exceptions, filing delays, alt-service disputes, and e-filing issues.
    • Ability to learn new legal and regulatory frameworks quickly. You do not need to be an expert on day one, but you need to get there fast.

    Strongly Preferred

    • Experience working with creditors' rights law firms or in the broader law firm space. You understand how these firms operate, who makes decisions, and what matters to them.
    • Familiarity with service of process: service attempts, affidavit of service, e-filing, substituted service. Or a demonstrated ability to get fluent within 60 days.
    • Prior experience with legal technology platforms, case management software, or process serving systems.
    • Exposure to compliance-driven client relationships with audit programs, vendor questionnaires, SLA reporting requirements, and formal review cadences.

Why Proof

The Market

Creditors' rights firms are under increasing pressure to use vendors that can document clean service, hold up under audit, and file on time across multiple jurisdictions. Proof is purpose-built for that environment. The firms filing the most cases are actively looking for a better solution, and we are the platform positioned to win that business.

The Role

The creditors' rights team is small and moving fast. You will have direct visibility into every account, direct access to the leadership making product and operational decisions, and real ownership over outcomes. This is not a role where you manage a queue.

Compensation

  • $130,000 base salary ($170,000 OTE)

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, and 401k available
  • Work-from-home monthly stipend
  • Flexible time off (paid planned and sick time, and paid holidays)
  • Necessary equipment provided

jobs.description:
Area Vice President, Public Sector

About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

About the Public Sector team

  • Sierra recently received FedRAMP High certification and were awarded our first contract with a federal agency. We’re now building our founding public sector team to redefine the relationship between the government and its citizenry.

  • Today, our agents already enable citizens to access social services, report fraud, and understand complex government systems. Simultaneously, they empower government officials to better hear the concerns and inquiries of their constituencies.

  • We are explicitly nonpartisan and committed to empowering public servants to leverage AI to advance their important missions.

  • In our journey, we are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

What you'll do

  • Build and lead Sierra’s public sector sales team: Recruit, develop, and lead a team of account executives serving strategic federal, state, or local government accounts. Set clear expectations, coach for performance, and build a culture of customer obsession, accountability, and consistent execution.

  • Own revenue growth and territory strategy: Translate Sierra’s public sector ambitions into territory coverage, account priorities, pipeline goals, and revenue plans. Allocate resources thoughtfully, maintain rigorous forecasts, and drive the team to consistently achieve or exceed revenue targets.

  • Create opportunities around mission outcomes: Build executive relationships with agency leaders and help your team translate priorities such as constituent access, service delivery, workforce effectiveness, and program integrity into compelling AI agent opportunities. Serve as an executive sponsor for strategic accounts.

  • Guide complex sales cycles from discovery through award: Coach account executives through long, multi-stakeholder government buying processes and engage directly at critical moments. Mobilize cross-functional support for executive alignment, solution development, business cases, security and legal reviews, pricing, proposal strategy, negotiation, and close.

  • Shape acquisition and capture strategy: Ensure every priority opportunity has a credible path to contract and a disciplined capture plan. Help the team navigate funding, fiscal-year timing, competitive dynamics, and procurement pathways—including GSA schedules, GWACs, IDIQs, BPAs, state schedules, and cooperative purchasing agreements. Lead deal reviews that surface risks early and turn strategy into clear next steps.

  • Scale Sierra’s partner ecosystem: Partner with public sector and partnerships leadership to build productive relationships with prime contractors, systems integrators, resellers, distributors, small-business partners, and technology providers. Guide decisions about direct sales, subcontracting, teaming, and partner-led transactions to expand customer access and accelerate growth.

  • Lead strategic prime and teaming relationships: Establish executive alignment with key partners and help shape account ownership, deal registration, workshare, and joint go-to-market plans. Ensure partnerships bring meaningful customer access, past performance, implementation capacity, or procurement pathways—and translate into qualified pipeline and successful delivery.

  • Drive disciplined pursuit and proposal decisions: Partner with the Public Sector GM on bid/no-bid recommendations and prioritize resources across strategic pursuits. Align sales, legal, security, product, engineering, and delivery teams to produce procurement responses that are compliant, differentiated, and precise.

  • Stay accountable for customer success: Build trust with senior agency leaders, establish strong handoffs from sales to delivery, and remain engaged through deployment and expansion. Help resolve escalations and ensure commitments made during the sales process support lasting customer relationships.

  • Build a repeatable public sector go-to-market motion: Work with public sector leadership to refine account segmentation, hiring and capacity plans, capture processes, partner strategy, contract-vehicle priorities, and sales playbooks. Bring market signals and customer feedback to product and company leadership to shape Sierra’s platform and public sector strategy.

  • Lead an AI-native sales organization: Embed AI into how the team researches accounts, develops outreach, synthesizes calls, plans opportunities, creates proposals, and forecasts. Model effective use, share successful practices, and help account executives spend more time on judgment, strategy, and customer relationships.

What you'll bring

  • 15+ years of selling experience: Extensive experience in enterprise customer-facing sales role, specifically selling to the U.S. government.

  • People leadership experience: 10+ years managing, mentoring, and developing a high-performing enterprise sales team.

  • Enterprise experience: You've run and managed end-to-end complex deals ($1M+).

  • Strong fluency in government acquisition and procurement, including funding and budget cycles, competitive solicitations, proposal processes, task orders, and common Federal or state contract vehicles.

  • Experience developing and executing capture strategies before a solicitation is released—not simply responding once an RFP is public.

  • A strong network and demonstrated ability to work with government technology partners, including prime contractors, systems integrators, resellers, distributors, and small-business teaming partners.

  • Sound judgment about direct, channel, prime/subcontractor, and teaming models, with the ability to select and execute the right path for a particular agency and opportunity.

  • The ability to build credibility with agency executives, program leaders, contracting and procurement officials, security teams, and technical stakeholders—and to align those groups around a shared path forward.

  • Excellent executive communication, negotiation, account planning, and forecasting skills. You are rigorous about details, procurement milestones, and next steps.

  • A passion for public sector work and a belief in the potential of government institutions to improve outcomes for the people they serve.

  • Comfort operating with high ownership in an early-stage business: you create structure where it does not yet exist, move with urgency, and collaborate deeply across functions.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team.
